«ΟΛΟΙ ΣΤΗΝ ΑΠΕΡΓΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΣΤΟΥΣ ΔΡΟΜΟΥΣ!


ΚΑΙ ΤΩΡΑ, ΓΕΝΙΚΗ ΑΠΕΡΓΙΑ!




Η νεολαία έχει ήδη πάρει τον δρόμο της. Η κοινωνική οργή αυξάνεται ενάντια σε μια ολοένα και πιο αποδυναμωμένη κυβέρνηση. Τα τελευταία τρία Σάββατα, εκατοντάδες χιλιάδες από εμάς έχουμε βγει στους δρόμους για να διαμαρτυρηθούμε για το υψηλό κόστος ζωής και να απαιτήσουμε τα δικαιώματα και τις ελευθερίες μας. Ήρθε η ώρα να απαιτήσουμε αλλαγή!




Η οργή πρέπει να επεκταθεί στους χώρους εργασίας και να επηρεάσει την οικονομία. Η CNT-SO ζητά την οικοδόμηση της διακλαδικής απεργίας της 5ης Νοεμβρίου στους χώρους εργασίας μας. Πρέπει να είναι όσο το δυνατόν πιο εκτεταμένη και να επιτρέπει τη δημιουργία αυτοοργανωμένων δομών (γενικές συνελεύσεις, απεργιακές επιτροπές κ.λπ.) για το μέλλον.




Στις εταιρείες ή τις υπηρεσίες μας, ας πολλαπλασιάσουμε τις συγκρούσεις για τις συνθήκες εργασίας μας και για τους μισθούς μας και ας συγκλίνουμε σε έναν μόνο στόχο: την ισότιμη κατανομή του πλούτου και της εργασίας.




Οι εργαζόμενοι εξακολουθούν να επηρεάζονται σε μεγάλο βαθμό από τον πληθωρισμό και το υψηλό κόστος ζωής (τρόφιμα, ενέργεια, στέγαση κ.λπ.). Οι μισθοί δεν συμβαδίζουν με τον ρυθμό στον ιδιωτικό τομέα, όπου οι κατώτατοι μισθοί που ορίζονται σε πολλές συλλογικές συμβάσεις υπερισχύουν συνεχώς από τον εθνικό κατώτατο μισθό· και στον δημόσιο τομέα, όπου το σημείο αναφοράς πρόκειται να παγώσει για τέταρτο έτος.




Ωστόσο, υπό την προεδρία του Μακρόν, οι πλουσιότεροι Γάλλοι πολίτες έχουν αυξήσει σημαντικά τον πλούτο τους. Οι τιμές των μετοχών, τα εταιρικά κέρδη και τα μερίσματα των μετόχων βρίσκονται σε ιστορικά υψηλά.




Δεν πρόκειται απλώς για ζήτημα αγοραστικής δύναμης, αλλά για την ισότιμη κατανομή του πλούτου. Αυτά τα τεράστια χρηματικά ποσά δημιουργήθηκαν από την εκμετάλλευση της εργασίας μας, πρέπει να επιστρέψουν στους εργάτες! Αμέσως, πρέπει να χρησιμοποιηθούν για μια γενική αύξηση των μισθών! Η καταπολέμηση των δυσκολιών του υψηλού κόστους ζωής σημαίνει ότι πρέπει να πληρώσουμε τους εργοδότες και τους μετόχους μας!




Οι νέοι απαιτούν περισσότερους πόρους για την εκπαίδευση, αλλά το 2027, η κυβέρνηση σχεδιάζει περικοπές στον προϋπολογισμό κατά 54 δισεκατομμύρια ευρώ, εξοικονομώντας μόνο τις στρατιωτικές δαπάνες, οι οποίες αυξάνονται κατά 11%. Αυτό αποτελεί κήρυξη πολέμου στις δημόσιες υπηρεσίες και τους υπαλλήλους τους. Αυτές οι περικοπές στον προϋπολογισμό δεν επηρεάζουν μόνο τους δημόσιους υπαλλήλους. Τελικά, είναι πάντα οι χρήστες που υποφέρουν! Απαίσια φροντίδα στα επείγοντα, μη αντικατάσταση εκπαιδευτικών, έλλειψη υδροβολής για την κατάσβεση πυρκαγιών, εγκαταλελειμμένα έργα από τους δήμους μας, λιγότερη χρηματοδότηση για τους συλλόγους μας, κατάργηση προγραμμάτων υποστήριξης… Όλοι υποφέρουμε τις συνέπειες!




Επί χρόνια, οι επιχειρηματικοί και οι μετόχοι τομείς επιδοτούνται με δημόσιο χρήμα (απαλλαγές από εισφορές κοινωνικής ασφάλισης και φόρους, επιδοτήσεις κ.λπ.). Αυτό αποτελεί συγκράτηση του κοινωνικοποιημένου μέρους των μισθών (του ακαθάριστου μισθού που χρηματοδοτεί την κοινωνική προστασία), ενώ υφιστάμεθα ένα ακόμη σημαντικό πισωγύρισμα με τη μείωση της ηλικίας συνταξιοδότησης στα 64 έτη και νέους περιορισμούς στην ασφάλιση ανεργίας και τα επιδόματα άδειας ασθενείας. Αυτές οι πολιτικές πρέπει να σταματήσουν προκειμένου να χρηματοδοτηθεί η κοινωνική προστασία, να απαλλάσσονται οι δημόσιες υπηρεσίες από τα μέτρα λιτότητας και να βελτιωθεί η κατάσταση των εργαζομένων τους.




ΑΣ ΧΤΙΣΟΥΜΕ ΤΗ ΓΕΝΙΚΗ ΑΠΕΡΓΙΑ!




ΜΕ ΤΗΝ CNT-SO, ΑΠΑΙΤΟΥΜΕ:




-Γενική αύξηση των μισθών με αναλογική κλίμακα ανάλογα με την αύξηση του κατώτατου μισθού.




-Αύξηση των συντάξεων και των παροχών κοινωνικής πρόνοιας προσαρμοσμένων στον πληθωρισμό. Αύξηση του δείκτη μισθοδοσίας των δημοσίων υπαλλήλων σύμφωνα με τον πληθωρισμό και προσαρμογή των μισθολογικών κλιμάκων. Πλαφόν στους υψηλούς μισθούς.




-Μείωση του ωραρίου εργασίας, με ίση αμοιβή.




-Ίσες αμοιβές για άνδρες και γυναίκες.




-Παύση πολιτικών, ιδίως δημοσιονομικών, που ωφελούν τους πλουσιότερους και επιχειρήσεις.




-Κατάσταση κοινωνικής έκτακτης ανάγκης: πάγωμα των ενοικίων, των τιμών των βασικών αγαθών και των λογαριασμών ενέργειας.




-Απόσυρση της συνταξιοδοτικής μεταρρύθμισης του 2023 και όλων των αντιμεταρρυθμίσεων από το 1993.




-Απόσυρση των τελευταίων μεταρρυθμίσεων στην ασφάλιση ανεργίας. Η επέκταση των δικαιωμάτων και η καθολική πρόσβαση σε επιδόματα ανεργίας με ελάχιστο μισθό ίσο με τον κατώτατο μισθό.




Οι δυσκολίες μας δεν προέρχονται από το πουθενά. Είναι το προϊόν του αρπακτικού και άνισου καπιταλιστικού οικονομικού συστήματος. Τα κοινωνικά κινήματα πολλαπλασιάζονται και η επίγνωση της ανάγκης για μια ριζική ρήξη με αυτό το κοινωνικό μοντέλο αυξάνεται. Χωρίς να ευθυγραμμιζόμαστε με τους αγώνες εξουσίας των πολιτικών κινημάτων, μπορούμε να υπερασπιστούμε ένα εναλλακτικό κοινωνικό έργο, που θα καθοδηγείται εξ ολοκλήρου από το κοινωνικό κίνημα. Ας οικοδομήσουμε μαζί αυτό το χειραφετητικό έργο για την τάξη μας, βασισμένο στην γνήσια οικονομική και κοινωνική ισότητα, την άμεση δημοκρατία και την αυτοδιαχείριση.




ΣΥΝΔΙΚΑΤΟ! ΔΡΑΣΗ! ΑΥΤΟΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗ!»

author: Eibhlin Priestley
title: After the Revolution, Before the War: Tracing Khartoum’s Syrian Community
content:
On 18 March 2023, Arwa Ahmed, an architect, and photographer of the Sudanese revolution, and I stood chatting in the shade of the Grand Hotel on Nile Street in Khartoum. We had spent the morning jumping in and out of Arwa’s white Hyundai photographing buildings of historic significance for the Syrian community. The quiet of the afternoon was broken as ten trucks, each holding dozens of men in civilian dress drove past us at speed. It was an unusual sight, one that we commented on at the time. Less than a month later, we would realise these men were fighters from the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) bussed into Khartoum to battle the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) unleashing hell on the people of Sudan on 15 April 2023. The country has since suffered what UNHCR has described as the most devastating humanitarian and displacement crisis in the world, largely out of sight of media attention.




Entrance to the Grand Hotel, Nile Street, a popular choice for Syrian weddings in the 1950s and 1960s. Photo by Arwa Ahmed.




Eighteen months into my History PhD, I arrived in Khartoum in March 2023 to meet and interview members of the Syrian community whose grandparents or great-grandparents arrived in Sudan from Greater Syria (today’s Syria, Lebanon, Palestine, and Jordan) at the turn of the twentieth century. I was warmly welcomed into homes with cooling glasses of 

karkade

 (hibiscus tea) and 

gungulaise

 (baobab juice) served alongside bowls of peanuts and salted plaited cheese before settling into long conversations about multi-generational family histories and the changing fortunes of the community over time.




Shrine to the Virgin Mary at the Melkite Catholic Church on Jumhuriya Street. The church was a central social, cultural, and religious hub until the community’s departure in April 2023. Photo by Arwa Ahmed.




The Syrians were one of several migrant communities – Greek, Italian, Armenian, Jewish – whose prosperity in the early and mid-20

th

 century was underpinned by their commercial activities. The earliest group of Syrians who settled in Sudan in the 1870s were merchants, mostly hailing from Aleppo, primarily operating in interregional trade of goods such as elephant tusks, ostrich feathers, leather, Arabic gum, and Syrian cotton and silk. The 1900s saw a new wave of Syrian migration to the newly created Anglo-Egyptian Condominium of Sudan, driven by anti-Christian persecution, economic opportunities, and government recruitment of physicians and administrators (principally from the Syrian Protestant College, now the American University of Beirut). One of these graduates was Nicola Malouf who opened a pharmacy and clinic on Mek Nimr Avenue in early 1920s next door to the family home. Within the same decade, he acquired substantial farmland outside Khartoum which he developed into a large-scale agricultural enterprise.




Norma Kfouri in her home in Khartoum. Photo by Arwa Ahmed.




By the 1950s, businessmen from the Syrian community such as Nicola Malouf occupied a central role in the Sudanese economy. They were among the nation’s leading industrialists, owning factories specialising in weaving, knitting, and cigarette and soap production, and were active in export trade, raw material extraction, and agricultural and dairy enterprises. My first meeting in Khartoum was with Norma Kfouri, his daughter, the longest standing member of the community. Described to me at a party as ‘Khartoum’s most important ambassador’ given the central role she played in city’s social milieu, she led a vibrant social life heading up a women’s charitable foundation, attending philanthropic events and parties, and hosting gatherings at her pink and yellow villa on the Nile.




The 1950s and 1960s are remembered as the ‘golden years’ when the Syrian community numbered several hundred families and concentrated itself in the capital. A significant number of women interviewed described ‘living like queens’ in this period, facilitated in large part by Sudanese domestic workers who cleaned and maintained homes, shopped and helped prepare meals, and cared for their children.




Mek Nimr Street, home to a number of Syrian families in the 1950s. Photo by Arwa Ahmed.




The 

Nadi

 (the Syrian club), churches, and schools were repeatedly mentioned as institutions which forged enduring friendships and a strong sense of identity as the ‘Syrians of Sudan’ which continues to bind the community, despite its dispersal today. The 

Nadi

 was the epicentre of community life and described as a second home. For several generations, it was a place of courtships and wedding celebrations, children’s parties and bingo, teenage midnight swims, weekly catch ups over scotch and a Syrian buffet, and extravagant Christmas and New Year’s Eve parties which in the 1950s and 1960s finished with breakfast on the airport terrace watching the planes soaring above. In an interview conducted in Sydney in 2023, Mary Hanoun-Khilla described the ways the 

Nadi

 supported the community through life’s ups and downs:




[It] provided the partner for the marriage, the solution for a difficult problem, the condolences for someone [who died]. It provided the visit if you are alone, for example, if your husband travelled and you’re not coping with the kids, it provide[d] all this sort of thing.




The outdoor stage at the Nadi. Photo by Arwa Ahmed.




In 1970, Jaafar Nimeiri’s nationalisations and confiscations of foreign-owned businesses began to erode the Syrians’ privileged position in Sudanese society. A number of large-scale businesses were seized, and the first families began to leave the country. Despite this rupture, most of the community retained their prosperity and social standing up until the sudden introduction of Shar’ia law under President Nimeiri in 1983 and rumours of conscription. This led a significant proportion to depart quietly for Australia, America, Canada, England, and Switzerland in what was known as the ‘phenomenon of the summer holidays’ as students and their families left for their summer holidays abroad and did not return.




Comboni College. Established in 1929, the Catholic school was attended by many boys in the Syrian community. Photo by Arwa Ahmed.




***




During a subsequent trip to Sydney to meet those who had left in the 1980s and 1990s, many expressed regret that their children and grandchildren today could never experience the closeness of community life and sense of belonging that defined this time in Khartoum. While the 

Nadi 

maintained its social significance for the community up until 2023, though it too changed with the arrival of a new demographic of Syrian refugees after 2011, the majority of the shops and factories had long been sold and since demolished or repurposed.




Souk al-Arabi housed to a number Syrian-owned textiles and haberdashery shops up until the 1980s. Photo by Arwa Ahmed.




I met Arwa at a group exhibition of photographers who documented the Sudanese revolution of 2018–2019. We subsequently decided to collaborate on a photography project about the urban history of the Syrian community in Sudan. What we didn’t realise was that it would turn into a documentation of a city about to be destroyed. Born in Khartoum in 1987, Arwa grew up borrowing her father’s Yashica, encouraged by him to document her friendships and important milestones through school and university. Arwa had different memories and experiences of the places the Syrian community had spoken of. For her, Nile Street, a tree-lined avenue running parallel to the Blue Nile, home to the University of Khartoum and the Republican Palace, was where she participated in, and photographed, the revolution in 2019. Driven by non-violence, democratic ideals, and broad societal participation, the revolution brought an end to the thirty year al-Bashir regime and saw in a transitional government which lasted until the military coup of 2021 led by General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan who heads the SAF today.




A protestor carrying a Sudanese flag climbs a billboard at the sit-in. Photo by Arwa Ahmed.




Arwa described the elation and sense of purpose she felt joining the sit-in at the military headquarters in Khartoum:




After we finished our jobs, we used to go to the sit-in after work. I remember one Sunday, we went in working hours, all our colleagues from the office. We talked to HR and said we really had to be there. We went to the sit-in, even our direct manager was with us. We thought we were making history so we were really passionate about going there. Our voices were heard for the first time in my life. That’s what it felt like at that time.




Omar al-Bashir was toppled on 11 April 2019, less than a week after protestors established the sit-in at the military headquarters. The sit-in continued until the Khartoum Massacre on 3 June 2019. Photo by Arwa Ahmed.




Artists, musicians, and photographers played a central role in the revolution, painting murals, leading chants, and photographing demonstrations and sit-ins. Arwa explained how the increased presence of protestors with cameras on the street changed the way photography, which had long been suppressed by the regime’s security services, was understood by the general public.




Protesters hold signs demanding at least 50% female representation in the transitional government, social and regional diversity, and justice for women affected by war and conflict. Photo by Arwa Ahmed.




The Sudanese are really reserved. They are sceptical…the general field of photography was not there. “Are you a journalist? Will my picture be in the newspapers?” They were not comfortable to be in front of the camera. But when the revolution happened, then this perspective shifted. People were like, “Photographs, yes. Please photograph me.” They were holding signs. The perspective shifted to, photography can really make ideas, change the point of view and reach other places. So it was really different after the revolution, the general perspective about photography.




A group of protestors wave to Arwa, united in hope for a new Sudan. Photo by Arwa Ahmed.




For Arwa, the revolution politicised her photography practice as activists sought to challenge pro-regime narratives in the media:




[When] the revolution came, I found photography mattered most because the mainstream media, for us, [was] not saying the things that we [we’]re seeing on [the] ground. So it was important to reflect what was really happening and we used social media for that. People always believe photos, you can write hundreds of articles but one photo can reflect what’s really happening.




Protestors aboard the ‘Freedom Train’ arrive in Khartoum on August 17 having travelled over 300km from Atbara to celebrate the transition to civilian rule. Photo by Arwa Ahmed.




***




Once we were both safely out of the country, Arwa caught up over video call. We reflected on the occurrence outside the hotel and the unsettling knowledge that in early April the final preparations for war were being made behind the scenes.




While we had intended this collection of photos to record the urban history of the Syrian community in Khartoum, these images capture snapshots of the city in the weeks before it was devastated by gunfire, bombing, looting, and mass displacement. After over 150 years in Sudan, the Syrian community’s presence in Khartoum is now non-existent as the majority of the remaining 50 families, like so many across the country, fled to Egypt at the end of April 2023. None have returned. As they focus on rebuilding their lives in Egypt or migrating elsewhere, these photographs stand as testimony to the last traces of the Syrian community’s rich history in Khartoum, the country’s unfinished revolution, and its uncertain future.




This research was supported by the University of Cambridge’s Language Sciences Impact Fund.




The post 

After the Revolution, Before the War: Tracing Khartoum’s Syrian Community

 appeared first on 

African Arguments

title: Πανεκπαιδευτικά συλλαλητήρια – μήνυμα συνέχισης του αγώνα
content:
Στους δρόμους κατέβηκαν εκ νέου σήμερα εκπαιδευτικοί, φοιτητές, μαθητές, διεκδικώντας μιά καλύτερη ζωή, φωνάζοντας ενάντια στο κόστος ζωής, σπουδών, στέγης και στέλνοντας διεθνιστικά μηνύματα από τη Γαλλία μέχρι την Παλαιστίνη, ενάντια στους πολέμους και τα κέρδη των κυρίαρχων. Επιπλέον, οι σημερινές πορείες είχαν έντονο αντιφασιστικό χρώμα, μετά και την επίθεση φασιστών σε μαθητές στην Πάτρα.




Πλήθος και ποικίλα ήταν τα συνθήματα που ακούστηκαν ή αναγραφόταν στα πανό των διαδηλωτών: Από τη Γαλλία σ’ ολόκληρη τη γη, η νεολαία εξεγείρεται για καλύτερη ζωή. Λεφτά για την παιδεία, όχι για τον πόλεμο και την αστυνομία. Όσο μας παίνεται την παιδεία, θα παίρνουμε τους δρόμους. Από την Ελλάδα μέχρι τη Γαλλία, παλεύουμε για δωρεάν δημόσια παιδεία. Δουλειές για το στρατό, τα πανεπιστήμια βρωμάνε ολοκληρωτισμό. Δημόσιο σχολείο για όλα τα παιδιά.  Δωρεάν παιδεία, ασφαλείς υποδομές. Να σπουδάσουμε ή να επιβιώσουμε. Όσο μιά φραγάτα, αξίζει όλη η Γκράβα. Σε Ελλάδα, Γαλλία, Αλβανία, το δίκιο το έχουν οι εξεγερμένοι, αλληλεγγύη στο διεθνές φοιτητικό κίνημα. Κάτω τα χέρια από τους συμαθητές μας, έξω οι φασίστες από τα σχολεία μας. Ούτε στα σχολεία μας ούτε πουθενά, μπλόκο στους φασίστες σε κάθε γειτονιά. Antifa μαθητές. Η Γαλλικά νεολαία μας δείχνει το δρόμο, αγώνας μαζικός ενάντια σε φτώχεια, ταξικούς φραγμούς, καταστολή. La beaute est dans la rue.

author: James Green
title: Todos os erros do presidente
content:
O tsunami democrata que varreu os Estados Unidos no dia 3 de novembro minou completamente o futuro político de Donald Trump, bem como o do movimento MAGA (Torne a América Grande Novamente, em inglês). Os resultados surpreenderam até mesmo os consultores de campanha democratas mais otimistas. A 

NBC News

 projeta que os democratas terão uma maioria estimada de 259 cadeiras na Câmara dos Representantes, contra 176 dos republicanos — um ganho de 45 parlamentares. No Senado, os democratas contarão com uma maioria de, pelo menos, cinco cadeiras.




A derrota eleitoral foi tão contundente e devastadora para o partido de Trump que o presidente não encontrou espaço político para alegar fraude eleitoral ou tentar interferir nos resultados em estados-chave, como muitos observadores previam que faria.

 Em suma, os eleitores enviaram uma 

mensagem

 clara de repúdio às políticas e práticas da Casa Branca durante a administração de Trump.




Trump cometeu muitos erros de cálculo político na preparação para as eleições. Convencido de que sua popularidade entre sua base levaria os candidatos republicanos à vitória, Trump insistiu em fazer campanha em estados conservadores

 como Iowa, Mississippi, Ohio, Kansas e Texas, onde venceu a eleição presidencial de 2024 por margens de dois dígitos. A presença de Trump nesses estados provou ser o canário na mina de carvão, um aviso prévio de que os republicanos temiam a derrota que, de fato, ocorreu.




Nos comícios do presidente, com participação menor do que em 2024, ele implorou aos seus apoiadores mais leais que imaginassem que ele estava na cédula e votassem de acordo com isso. No entanto, candidatos republicanos em disputas acirradas pediram ao presidente que não fosse aos seus estados, temendo que isso influenciasse os eleitores a favor de seus oponentes.




A estratégia de Trump, em 2025, de insistir que os republicanos redesenhassem os mapas dos distritos eleitorais, conhecida como 

gerrymandering

, para diluir o poder de voto dos democratas, dividindo esses eleitores em distritos recém-criados com maioria republicana, também saiu pela culatra. 

Em parte, os republicanos redesenharam as fronteiras dos distritos com base em uma mudança de voto entre latinos, homens negros e jovens nas eleições presidenciais de 2024, que passaram a apoiar Trump. No entanto, os três grupos 

retornaram

 ao Partido Democrata.




Os latinos, que eram a favor do controle governamental na fronteira sul, se opuseram à forma como o Serviço de Imigração e Alfândega (ICE) realizou prisões e assassinatos em massa em todo o país.




Decisões da Suprema Corte apoiadas por Trump, que diluíram o poder de voto dos negros, desagradaram eleitores, especialmente no Sul, que retornaram ao campo democrata.




E os jovens, alarmados com o alto custo de vida e com a sensação de que suas oportunidades futuras eram limitadas, também viraram as costas para Trump.




Os republicanos do Texas iniciaram essa manobra de redistribuição de distritos, na esperança de ganhar cinco cadeiras adicionais na Câmara. É provável que percam todos os cinco distritos recém-redesenhados. A Califórnia respondeu também redesenhando seus mapas de distritos congressionais e obtendo a aprovação esmagadora da proposta em um referendo. Ao contrário dos republicanos, eles conquistaram todos os cinco novos distritos da Califórnia.




Esforços semelhantes, porém, mais modestos, de redistribuição de distritos em outros estados também não favoreceram os republicanos. Em resumo, mais um 

erro de cálculo

 político da Casa Branca.




Uma eleição de muitos ‘pela primeira vez na história dos EUA’




Embora alguns resultados ainda estejam sendo contabilizados, parece que os democratas também obterão ganhos significativos nas eleições estaduais e locais em todo o país.

 

Pela primeira vez

 em muitos anos, os democratas controlarão as legislaturas estaduais em estados-chave, como New Hampshire, Minnesota, Pensilvânia, Texas e Wisconsin. Isso lhes permitirá, por exemplo, aprovar legislação para enfrentar o alto custo de vida, reduzindo os impostos estaduais e locais sobre gasolina e diesel, a fim de reduzir os preços recordes dos combustíveis, impulsionados pela guerra no Irã.




Contudo, lideranças democratas já deixaram claro que, se não reduzirem o custo de vida, poderão perder rapidamente, na eleição de 2028, o voto daqueles que romperam com o Partido Republicano para apoiar candidatos da oposição nesta temporada eleitoral.




É significativo notar que os democratas 

venceram disputas parlamentares

 em estados cruciais que, tradicionalmente, apoiavam os republicanos — Geórgia, Iowa, Kansas, Maine, Carolina do Sul e Texas —, redesenhando o mapa político do país. Os democratas também derrotaram candidatos republicanos ao cargo de governador em “estados decisivos” (

swing states

) — aqueles em que o eleitorado oscila entre os dois partidos a cada eleição —, o que torna mais difícil para Trump manipular o processo eleitoral presidencial de 2028, no qual o candidato que conquista a maioria dos votos em um estado obtém a totalidade dos votos do Colégio Eleitoral.




Após dois anos de esforços da administração Trump para desmantelar os programas de “

diversidade, equidade e inclusão

”, a eleição marcou várias “primeiras vezes”, ampliando a composição racial, étnica e religiosa dos funcionários eleitos, tanto federais quanto estaduais. Nas eleições para o Senado, os eleitores escolheram Abdul El Sayed, de Michigan, um muçulmano de esquerda, para servir naquela casa, e Chris Pappas, de New Hampshire, será o primeiro senador abertamente gay. Os eleitores elegeram Gina Hinojosa, do Texas, a primeira latina a se tornar governadora do estado. Keisha Lance-Bottom será a primeira mulher negra a assumir esse cargo na Geórgia, e a nativa americana Deb Haaland, do Novo México, será a primeira mulher indígena nessa posição. Além disso, Xavier Bessera é o primeiro latino a se tornar governador da Califórnia.




Nos meses que antecederam as eleições, as pesquisas de opinião mostraram que, em média, 65% da população registrava ampla rejeição às políticas de Trump, desde as tarifas até a guerra no Irã.

 Os resultados eleitorais confirmaram essa avaliação. De acordo com entrevistas da 

MSNow

 com eleitores que saíram das urnas ou votaram por correspondência antes do dia da eleição, 90% dos entrevistados disseram que seus dois principais motivos para votar foram o estado deplorável da economia e a corrupção desenfreada em Washington. A oposição à guerra não ficou muito atrás entre as preocupações dos eleitores.




Claramente, as 

insistentes a

l

egações

 de Trump durante a campanha de que a questão da “acessibilidade financeira” (

affordability

) é uma farsa e que os Estados Unidos têm “a melhor economia de todos os tempos” soaram falsas, mesmo entre muitos apoiadores de Trump que ficaram em casa ou apoiaram candidatos democratas. Ao avaliar os resultados eleitorais, analistas republicanos argumentaram que o problema de seu partido não foi a participação, mas sim o fato de que muitos que apoiaram Trump em três eleições anteriores votaram nos democratas desta vez.




Até mesmo alguns dos candidatos mais proeminentes que Trump apoiou nas primárias republicanas altamente disputadas não conseguiram vencer a eleição geral.

 Entre os candidatos notoriamente controversos apoiados pelo presidente que acabaram derrotados, estavam o procurador-geral do Texas, Ken Paxton, que concorria contra James Talarico para o Senado, e o governador Greg Abbott, que cumpriu três mandatos; a candidata da Carolina do Sul, Darlene Graham, irmã do senador Lindsey Graham, apoiador de Trump e falecido recentemente; e candidatos republicanos fracos nas disputas para o Senado na Geórgia e na Carolina do Norte. Eles foram derrotados pelos democratas por margens de 10 pontos percentuais.




O que a nova frente no Congresso pode fazer contra Trump




Controlar a Câmara dos Representantes e o Senado com margens amplas é a principal arma que os democratas têm à disposição no momento. 

Embora possuam maioria em ambas as casas para aprovar leis que beneficiem aqueles que acabaram de apoiá-los, Trump ainda detém poder de veto sobre todas as leis aprovadas. O Congresso precisaria de uma maioria de dois terços para derrubar o veto do presidente.

 Isso exigirá encontrar republicanos que temam perder seus assentos em 2028 e que estejam dispostos a oferecer apoio bipartidário à legislação.




Entre as primeiras 

prioridades

 declaradas da nova maioria no Congresso, estará a realização de audiências sobre questões que os republicanos haviam impedido de serem discutidas. Isso provavelmente incluirá novas investigações sobre os “arquivos Epstein”, resoluções que invocam a Lei de Poderes de Guerra (

War Powers Act)

 para forçar Trump a encerrar a guerra no Irã, e apurações sobre a corrupção na família Trump. Os democratas terão o poder de intimar autoridades governamentais e outras testemunhas a depor sob juramento sobre esses assuntos, com consequências graves caso prestem informações falsas às investigações do Congresso.




Quais seriam, então, os próximos passos políticos de Trump? Dado o seu comportamento errático, é sempre difícil prever o que ele fará a seguir.




Após o segundo debate presidencial de 2016 entre Donald Trump e Hillary Clinton, o político britânico 

Nigel Farage

 comentou que Trump — assim como Flávio Bolsonaro no debate da Globo em 2026 — rondava Hillary Clinton enquanto ela falava, agindo como um gorila de dorso prateado. Agora que Trump apresenta sinais cada vez mais claros de deterioração mental — e tendo em mente essa comparação com primatas —, soube recentemente que gorilas-das-costas-prateados, ao envelhecerem, não se tornam passivos ou dóceis; pelo contrário, tornam-se mais agressivos à medida que sua saúde declina.




Embora Trump tenha admitido a derrota eleitoral, ele, como de costume, está culpando os outros, argumentando que, se estivesse na cédula, os republicanos teriam vencido. Embora ele afirme que precisará buscar entendimento com os democratas para aprovar novas leis, dado o seu comportamento passado, é difícil levar suas palavras a sério. Sua necessidade de denegrir oponentes, defender suas políticas tarifárias irracionais — que continuam a causar estragos na economia — e jamais admitir um erro ou fracasso não deixa margem para acreditar em qualquer possibilidade de mudança na personalidade de Trump.




Resta saber como isso afetará o Brasil. 

Com a derrota eleitoral avassaladora de Trump, é provável que os irmãos Bolsonaro sejam deixados em segundo plano por enquanto, para serem trazidos de volta à cena quando a sorte política do presidente estiver mais favorável.

 Além disso, a insistência de Flávio Bolsonaro em exercer seu direito a voto no Senado, mesmo tendo deixado o Brasil sem autorização do Congresso, torna mais difícil sustentar o mito de que o Brasil vive sob uma ditadura — especialmente quando a oposição detém a maioria no Legislativo.




O eleitorado americano frustrou os planos de Trump durante seus dois últimos anos de mandato. Trump reconhece que questões econômicas e a guerra no Irã foram fatores determinantes, mas, até o momento, não recuou na defesa de nenhuma dessas políticas. Enquanto isso, os republicanos entraram no “jogo de culpar o outro”. O vice-presidente 

Vance

 deu o primeiro passo ao atribuir a guerra no Irã à derrota eleitoral. Vance sempre se opôs a “incursões estrangeiras desnecessárias”, embora tenha abandonado essa postura para se tornar o fiel escudeiro de Trump. Agora que a temporada de campanha para a eleição presidencial de 2028 começou, ele parece tentar se distanciar do presidente. O “

banho de sangue

” parece ter começado.




E, nas ruas de Nova York, o desempenho surpreendentemente forte dos democratas despertou um sentimento de alívio e euforia — não muito diferente daquele sentido em 

25 de outubro

, quando o presidente Lula venceu o segundo turno das eleições com uma vitória expressiva.

author: By L. Cam Anderson, Contributor
title: Hennepin County Surveilled Anti-HERC Activists Since 2023
content:
Minneapolis, MN — A report released by the Zero Burn Coalition documents years of surveillance conducted against activists pushing for clean air in Minneapolis. The revelations came from documents that the organization obtained through public information requests.




At the center of this is the Hennepin Energy Recovery Center (HERC), a nearly 40-year-old trash incinerator neighboring Target Field in Minneapolis permitted to burn 365,000 tons of garbage annually. Activists, including those with the Zero Burn Coalition, have advocated for its closure for years, citing the amount of pollution it produces and the disproportionate effect on marginalized communities.




A short walk to the west of the facility is historically Black and working-class neighborhoods of North Minneapolis, which bear the brunt of the plant’s pollution. 




Coinciding with the release of the report on Oct. 22, community members and Minnesota Environmental Justice Table (MNEJT) activists and leaders convened along Olson Memorial Highway in the Heritage Park neighborhood for a press conference, in full view of HERC’s foreboding smoke stacks on the other side of Interstate 94.
















“Instead of addressing the concerns raised by residents, the county has devoted staff time and resources to tracking the people organizing for change,” MNEJT Associate Director Adina Black said. “This raises serious questions about accountability, transparency, and the county’s treatment of the communities it has a responsibility to serve.”




The 

eight-page report

 details seven separate instances of the county surveilling activists and the role former environmental justice leader Joe Vital played in that. 




Hennepin-Co-Surveillance-Report-Zero-Burn-Coalition







Vital was a part of 

the East Phillips Neighborhood Institute’s successful push

 to acquire the former Roof Depot site from the city of Minneapolis in 2023. Since then, he has become Hennepin County’s Environmental Engagement Coordinator and would attend activist meetings to feed his notes to other Hennepin County employees, such as the county’s Department of Environment and Energy Assistant Director David McNary.




The report alleges that Vital also attempted to learn the identity of a county whistleblower through conversation with Minnesota Environmental Justice Table’s co-founder Nazir Khan.




In emails acquired by the Zero Burn Coalition, McNary would forward alerts from the activists to Tim Steinbeck, the president of Great River Energy, the company operating HERC. McNary and Steinbeck both served simultaneously as the treasurer-secretary of Minnesota Resource Recovery Association, a group formed by leaders of the incinerator industry.




000124-000140







In March 2024, an amortization bill was introduced in the state legislature that would allow cities to phase out sources of pollution in vulnerable neighborhoods without requiring them to do so. The House committee considering the bill narrowed it to only the state’s largest cities.




Under Minnesota law at the time, amortization could only be used against adult-only stores and criminal nuisances.




While advocates rallied around the bill, McNary forwarded the private emails of activists to Steinbeck and other industry representatives, urging them to oppose it.




“They start with the big cities and before long it will be the entire state,” McNary wrote in the email thread while pushing the idea that the amortization process would come to affect other industries.




Read 

all of the documents published to the public by the Zero Burn Coalition

.







HERC, which began operation in 1989, is a “waste-to-energy” facility, meaning it produces energy for the power grid by incinerating garbage. Since its construction, the population within five kilometers of the plant has grown to nearly 250,000.




Despite politicians and others 

framing “waste-to-energy” as environmentally friendly

, 

a peer-reviewed study published in 2023

 found that “incinerators emit more greenhouse gas emissions per unit of electricity produced … than any other power source.” The study also added that the inclusion of incinerators in “‘renewable’ or ‘clean’ energy standards is thus counterproductive, as they also divert more than $40 million in subsidies annually from cleaner energy sources.”




HERC, which has been operated by Great River Energy since 2018, annually produces roughly 350,000 million tons of carbon dioxide and 72,000 million tons of incinerator ashes, according to a report published on Oct. 13 by the international environmental advocacy organization Global Alliance for Incinerator Alternatives (GAIA).




The report titled, 

The Burn Book: Incinerators that Threaten the Climare, Public Health, and our Finances

, covers 20 incinerator facilities from around the world, including three in the United States.




“This facility actually has garnered international attention,” Minnesota Environmental Justice campaign manager Isuru Herath said, referencing GAIA’s report. “So there’s no reason why Hennepin County cannot move towards actually setting the closure date because this issue extends beyond the state of Minnesota.”







The community response long predates the plant’s current opposition, going all the way back to 

hazmat suit-dressed protesters parading around the office

 of then-Hennepin County Commissioner Randy Johnson during the planning phase in the mid-1980s. Although the protests did not stop the project, they continued for the next several decades.




In October 2023, numerous organizations came together to form the Zero Burn Coalition, which explicitly focuses on and organizes against HERC, advocating for the facility’s complete closure.




“[HERC] concentrates pollution, health risk, and harm in neighborhoods that are disproportionately low-income and people of color, while wealthier parts of the county send their trash here and bear none of the burden,” the organization’s website reads.




On Oct. 24, 2023, the Hennepin County board of commissioners 

adopted a resolution

 to plan for the facility’s closure sometime between 2028 and 2040. The county’s 

Zero Waste Plan

, released that same year, calls specifically for a 90% reduction in waste from landfills and incinerators.




More than a year later, on Oct. 30, 2024, the Minneapolis City Council approved a resolution to permanently close HERC by Dec. 31, 2027. The resolution relied on the city’s 

2017 Zero Waste Plan

, a “road map for the city to achieve its waste reduction goals,” that plans for 80% of the city’s waste to be recycled or composted by 2030.




That resolution, however, is non-binding and does not actually force Hennepin County to close the plant within that time frame.




Zero Burn Coalition held a 

community response meeting

 on Thursday, Nov. 5.

title: Sat., November 21, 2026: NYC Mass Meeting to Defend the MN15 [Labor for Palestine endorsement]
content:

author: Shireen Akram-Boshar
title: Democrats Win in Districts Redrawn in Gerrymandering Efforts Pushed by Trump
content:
Democrats won seats in at least 12 districts that Republicans had redrawn in large-scale gerrymandering efforts.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

On Tuesday, Democrats won seats in at least 12 districts that Republicans had redrawn in large-scale gerrymandering efforts pushed by President Donald Trump and the GOP over the past year and a half.

Last summer, Trump pushed Republican-led states to redraw congressional maps in favor of the Republican Party, and to prevent a loss of power in the midterm elections. He first called on Texas Republicans to redistrict, and (now outgoing) Republican Gov. Greg Abbott obliged, redrawing boundaries based on race. In November 2025, a federal district court panel placed a temporary block on Abbott’s new map, ruling that there was evidence of racial gerrymandering. But the right-leaning Supreme Court reversed this decision, and allowed Abbott’s redistricted map to proceed for the midterm election.

North Carolina followed, redrawing its congressional maps in October 2025. Trump continued to pressure state legislatures, even threatening a campaign against Republicans in Indiana who didn’t support his project of gerrymandering.

Earlier this year, outgoing Florida Republican Gov. Ron DeSantis and the state’s Republican-controlled legislature redrew the state’s congressional map, redrawing four Democratic-held U.S. House districts to favor Republican candidates. In their redistricting in April, Republicans had “eliminated districts around Democratic-leaning cities,” and broken up Democratic-leaning areas around other cities, The New York Times explained.

But as of Thursday, amid the larger rebuke of Trump and the Republican party, Democrats in each of those four Florida districts — Kathy Castor, Pia Dandiya, Darren Soto, and Jared Moskowitz — have beaten or are poised to beat their Republican opponents.

In North Carolina, Republican legislatures had redrawn congressional lines before both the 2024 and 2026 elections, aiming to secure 11 of the state’s 14 districts for Republicans — but instead, Democrats won 9 of the 14 seats, with three still uncalled as of Thursday.

In Texas, gerrymandering converted five Democratic-held districts in 2025. Democrats nonetheless won four of those five seats.

In Alabama, Democratic Rep. Shomari Figures won reelection despite redistricting efforts that were deemed racist by the Supreme Court.

“We know what happened with this district,” Figures said in his victory speech on Tuesday. “We know about the redistricting efforts. We know what the district was, what the district is now. But we had a job to do, and so we put our hands to the plow and we did not look backwards. We kept moving forward.”

The mid-decade redistricting effort by Republicans was unusual — districts usually redraw congressional maps only at the start of each decade — and pointed to Republicans’ awareness of the drop in support for Trump and his administration. Nonetheless, Republicans found the defeats Tuesday worse than they anticipated.

Tuesday’s victories marked a widespread rejection of Trump’s rule, as well as a vote against Islamophobia and in favor of more solidarity with Palestine. However, grassroots efforts will still be needed to push the Democrats to enact a progressive alternative.

title: Özgür Özel, kurultay öncesi Yeni Parti’nin 17 maddelik çalışma programını açıkladı
content:
Yeni Parti Genel Başkanı Özgür Özel, partisinin kuruluş kurultayı öncesinde 17 başlıktan oluşan çalışma programını yayımladı ve genel başkanlığa yeniden aday olduğunu açıkladı. Özel, yapılacak ilk seçimlerde partisinin cumhurbaşkanı adayının seçilmesini ve TBMM’de çoğunluk elde etmeyi hedeflediklerini bildirdi.

Özel, partinin kuruluş aşamasından çıkarak toplumsal desteğini genişletmesini, üyelerin karar süreçlerindeki rolünü artırmasını ve ülkeyi yönetmeye hazır kadrolar oluşturmasını öncelikleri arasında saydı. Türkiye İttifakı’nı farklı siyasi geleneklerden ve toplumsal kesimlerden yurttaşları demokrasi, hukuk devleti, eşit yurttaşlık ve sosyal adalet etrafında buluşturacak bir işbirliği olarak tanımladı.

Özel, yargının siyasi amaçlarla kullanıldığını ve seçilmiş temsilcilerin görev yapmasının engellendiğini vurgulayarak bu uygulamalara karşı siyasi ve hukuki girişimleri sürdüreceklerini söyledi. Ekrem İmamoğlu’nun ve hedef alındığını belirttiği diğer siyasetçilerin haklarını savunacaklarını kaydetti.

Program, genel başkan ile il ve ilçe başkanlarının belirlenmesinde üyelerin doğrudan katıldığı eğilim yoklamalarının geliştirilmesini öngörüyor. Üyelerin parti kararlarına ve mali bilgilere erişmesi, yöneticilere yazılı soru yöneltmesi ve politika önerileri sunması için yeni kanallar oluşturulacak. Mahalle, ilçe ve il meclisleri yaygınlaştırılacak, dijital katılım platformu kurulacak ve gönüllüler de parti çalışmalarına katılabilecek.

Kadınların temsiline ilişkin kotaların daha etkin uygulanması ve gençlerin ekonomi ve dış politika dahil farklı alanlarda sorumluluk üstlenmesi de programda yer aldı. Özel, Siyaset Akademisi’nin eğitim programı, uygulama takvimi ve dijital altyapısının ilk altı ayda hazırlanmasını hedeflediklerini bildirdi.

Özel, aday belirleme, sandık güvenliği ve saha çalışmalarının ülke çapında ortak bir takvime bağlanacağını söyledi. Parti, iktidara gelmesi halinde ilk 100 günde, ilk yılda ve yasama dönemi boyunca atacağı adımları önceden belirleyecek. Ekonomi, kamu yönetimi, hukuk, eğitim, sağlık, güvenlik ve dış politika için hazırlanacak planlarda bütçe, personel ve mevzuat ihtiyaçları da ele alınacak.

Ekonomi programında üretim kapasitesinin artırılması, gelirin daha adil dağıtılması ve vergi adaletinin güçlendirilmesi hedefleniyor. Parti, ücretler ve emekliliğin yanı sıra sanayi, tarım, teknoloji, enerji ve istihdam alanlarında politika belgeleri hazırlayacak.

Özel, parti maliyesinde aidatların, bağışların ve satın almaların denetlenebilir olacağını, bağımsız Etik Kurulunun güçlendirileceğini ve faaliyetlerin altı ayda bir değerlendirileceğini bildirdi. Programda çıkar çatışması, mal varlığı beyanı, hediye ve bağışlar ile kampanya finansmanına ilişkin kuralların uygulanması da öngörülüyor.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Fransa: Öğrenci ve işçi grevleri birleşti, yüz binler ücret ve sosyal haklar için sokakta
content:
İşçi sendikalarının ücret artışı, emeklilik haklarının korunması, kamu hizmetlerinin güçlendirilmesi ve sosyal harcamalardaki kesintilerin durdurulması talepleriyle başlattığı Fransa çapındaki grev, lise ve üniversite öğrencilerinin katılımıyla perşembe günü geniş bir toplumsal gösteriye dönüştü. 




Paris, Marsilya, Lyon, Toulouse ve Nantes başta olmak üzere ülkenin birçok kentinde yürüyüşler düzenlenirken, İçişleri Bakanlığı öğle saatlerinde Paris dışındaki 180 gösteriye 270 bin kişinin katıldığını bildirdi.




Liselilerin başlattığı hareket bu noktaya nasıl geldi?




Fransa'da toplumsal hareketlilik eylülün ikinci yarısında, Paris yakınlarındaki Créteil'de öğretmen açığını protesto eden lise öğrencilerinin başlattığı eylemlerle bir dönüşüm geçirdi. Kalabalık sınıflar, bakımsız okul binaları, öğretmen eksikliği ve eğitimdeki eşitsizlikler kısa sürede ülke çapında ortak talepler hâlini aldı. Öğrenciler, eşitsizlikleri derinleştirdiğini savundukları üniversiteye giriş sistemi Parcoursup'un da kaldırılmasını istedi.




Ekim başında okul işgalleri, blokajlar ve yürüyüşlerle büyüyen hareket, 17 Ekim'den başlayarak hayat pahalılığına karşı gösterilerle buluştu. 17, 24 ve 31 Ekim'de düzenlenen üç büyük eylem dalgasına öğrencilerin yanı sıra sendikalar, emekçiler ve yeniden harekete geçen Sarı Yelekliler katıldı. Polis müdahaleleri, gözaltılar ve gösterilere getirilen kısıtlamalar da protestoların gündemine yerleşti.




Hükümetin eğitim koşullarını iyileştirme kapsamında açıkladığı sınırlı önlemler, öğrencilerin taleplerini karşılamadı. Kasımın ilk günlerinde liselerde eğitim yeniden dururken, üniversite öğrencileri de eylemlere katıldı. Öğretmen açığı ve eğitimdeki eşitsizliklere karşı başlayan hareket, ücretler, emeklilik, sosyal güvenlik ve kamu harcamaları için mücadeleyle ortaklaşmaya başladı.




Beş büyük sendika konfederasyonu CFDT, CGT, FO, FSU ve UNSA, bir ay öncesinden, 5 Ekim'de 5 Kasım için ortak grev çağrısında bulunmuştu. Sonraki haftalarda CFTC, Solidaires ve CFE-CGC de çağrıya katıldı. Sendikaların gündemindeki ücret ve sosyal haklar mücadelesi öğrencilerin eğitim talepleriyle aynı eylem takviminde buluştu.




Yüz binler sokakta, ulaşım ve eğitimde aksama




Sendikaların önceden açıkladığı takvime göre ülke genelinde yaklaşık 260 gösteri planlandı. İçişleri Bakanlığı ise 220'den fazla sokak eylemi beklediğini duyurdu.




Bakanlığın Fransa saatiyle 13.00 itibarıyla verdiği bilgiye göre Paris dışındaki 180 yürüyüşte 270 bin kişi bulunuyordu. CGT ise aynı saatlerde 73 kentte 250 binden fazla gösterici olduğunu açıkladı. Her iki veri de günün başındaki ilk katılım rakamlarıydı.




Başkent Paris'te yürüyüş, öğleden sonra République Meydanı'ndan Nation Meydanı'na doğru başladı. Sendika bayraklarının yanı sıra öğrencilerin eğitim hakkı taleplerini taşıyan pankartlar da kortejlerde yer aldı.




Grevin etkileri özellikle demiryolu ulaşımında ve eğitimde hissedildi. Ulusal demiryolu şirketi SNCF'nin dört büyük sendikası birlikte iş bırakma çağrısı yaparken, bazı bölgelerde tren seferleri aksadı. Sağlık çalışanları, posta emekçileri, hava ulaşımı personeli ve öğretmenler de grev çağrısının kapsamındaydı.




AP'nin haberine göre liselerin yaklaşık üçte birinde eğitim, öğrenci blokajları veya öğretmenlerin iş bırakması nedeniyle aksadı. Eğitim Bakanlığı ise devlet ilkokullarındaki öğretmenlerin yüzde 17,54'ünün greve katıldığını bildirdi. Paris'te Eyfel Kulesi de grev nedeniyle ziyarete kapatıldı.




Ücretler, emeklilik ve kamu hizmetleri




Sendikaların ortak talepleri arasında asgari ücretin yükseltilmesi, ücret pazarlıklarının derhal açılması, emekli aylıklarının korunması, istihdamın güvence altına alınması ve büyük servetlerin daha yüksek vergilendirilmesi yer alıyor.




Demiryolu sendikaları hükümetin bütçe tasarısının sosyal güvenlik harcamalarını azaltacağını, kamu çalışanlarının ücretlerini baskılayacağını ve yoksulluğu derinleştireceğini savunuyor.




Sendikalar ayrıca sanayide artan işten çıkarma planlarına ve kamu hizmetlerinin finansmanındaki daralmaya dikkat çekiyor. Hayat pahalılığı karşısında ücretlerin ve emekli aylıklarının geride kalması, öğrencilerle çalışanların ortak eyleminin başlıca nedenlerinden biri olarak öne çıkıyor.




CGT Genel Sekreteri Sophie Binet, grev öncesinde yaptığı açıklamada 5 Kasım'ın geniş bir toplumsal buluşma günü olması gerektiğini vurgulamıştı. Binet, bugün Paris'te yaptığı açıklamada da talepler karşılanmadıkça mücadelenin durmayacağını söyledi.




70 bin polis ve jandarma görevlendirildi




İçişleri Bakanı Laurent Nuñez, gösteriler için 70 bin polis ve jandarmanın görevlendirildiğini açıkladı. Güvenlik düzenlemeleri arasında 26 zırhlı Centaure aracı, insansız hava araçları, helikopterler ve toplumsal olaylara müdahale birlikleri bulunuyor.




Bakanlık, gösteri güzergâhlarının bazı merkezlerinden uzak tutulmasını ve sendikaların yürüyüşlerde güvenliği sağlayacak düzenlemeler yapmasını istedi. Paris'te sendikaların Bastille ile Concorde arasındaki yürüyüş önerisi kabul edilmedi; bunun yerine République–Nation güzergâhına izin verildi.




Sabah saatlerinde Paris'te bazı liselerin önündeki blokaj girişimlerine polis müdahale etti. Strasbourg'da öğrenciler dağıtıldı. Lyon, Rennes ve Toulouse'da da çeşitli gerilimler yaşandığı bildirildi.




İçişleri Bakanlığı, öğle saatlerinde yürüyüşlerin genel olarak sakin geçtiğini açıklarken, bazı kentlerde çatışmaların ve polis müdahalelerinin gerçekleştiğini bildirdi. İnsan hakları örgütleri ise son haftalarda öğrencilerin maruz kaldığı polis şiddetini ve gösteri hakkına getirilen kısıtlamaları eleştiriyor.




Mücadelenin yeni aşaması




5 Kasım grevi, Fransa'daki toplumsal hareketin bileşiminde önemli bir değişime işaret ediyor. Eylül'de eğitim sistemindeki sorunlardan doğan protestolar, Ekim boyunca hayat pahalılığına karşı eylemlerle yan yana ilerlemişti. Perşembe günü işçi grevleriyle öğrencilerin gösterileri buluştu.




Öğrenciler öğretmen, derslik ve eşit eğitim olanakları isterken, çalışanlar ücretlerinin ve sosyal haklarının korunmasını talep ediyor. İki hareket kamu kaynaklarının dağılımı ve geçim koşulları üzerindeki mücadelede ortaklaşıyor.




Sarı Yelekliler koordinasyonu da yalnızca 5 Kasım'daki sendikal eylem günüyle yetinilmemesini, 6 Kasım'da grev ve blokajların sürdürülmesini, 7 Kasım'da yeni gösteriler düzenlenmesini istedi. 




(AEK)

author: Chris Walker
title: Trump Is Still Trying to Undermine Voters’ Preferences in the Alaska Senate Race
content:
Six years after “STOP THE COUNT,” Trump is making a similar demand in Alaska’s closely contested Senate race.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

In a Truth Social post on Thursday morning, President Donald Trump demanded that officials stop counting votes in the U.S. Senate race in Alaska, and that all votes for third-party candidates be given to Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan — disregarding thousands of votes that are yet to be counted as well as voters’ preferences in a possible instant runoff.

The demand is highly unusual and undemocratic. It comes six years to the day that Trump made similar calls to “STOP THE COUNT” in an effort to stave off his 2020 election loss to former President Joe Biden.

Trump claims that the participation of another Dan Sullivan in the race has confused voters. Even if that’s true for some residents, Alaska has ranked-choice voting, allowing those voters to cast ballots for both Sullivans. The Department of Justice (DOJ) filed a lawsuit seeking to delay certification of the election if the incumbent Sullivan, a Trump loyalist, lost, which a federal judge tossed out earlier this week.

In his latest effort to upend the race, Trump insisted that the election be called for the Republican senator.

“The vote totals for the Fake Dan Sullivan, plus the other ‘slug’ that the Dems put on the Ballot, should be immediately given to the REAL Dan Sullivan, and the Election is over — He easily wins,” Trump claimed in his post. “There is no other fair solution!”

To do what Trump is demanding would disenfranchise potentially hundreds of thousands of voters whose ballots have not yet been counted. As of Thursday morning, only about 74 percent of ballots have been processed, meaning over a quarter of all votes in the state remain to be tallied.

The race remains incredibly close. Democrat Mary Peltola is currently leading Sen. Sullivan by just over 600 votes. Peltola doesn’t yet have a majority, however, which means that, if these trends hold until all ballots are counted, an instant runoff will be needed to determine a winner.

The second-preference votes for people who picked the other Dan Sullivan would be counted first, as he’s presently in fourth place in the race. Even if all of his votes go to either Peltola or Sen. Sullivan, they wouldn’t be enough to give either a majority, meaning that the secondary votes of the current third-place candidate, Republican Gerald Heikes, will also likely need to be tabulated.

It’s likely that Sen. Sullivan will receive more votes from Heikes than Peltola will, given that both are Republicans, but it’s not impossible for Peltola to eke out a win if enough backers of Heikes favor her over Sullivan.

If Peltola does win, she will become the eighth Democratic Senate candidate in the midterms to flip a Republican seat. Another closely watched race in Mississippi could be the eighth (if Peltola loses) or ninth flip for Dems, as Scott Colom (D) is currently leading incumbent Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith (R) by just a few hundred votes, with less than 4 percent of ballots left to be counted.

author: Unknown
title: Ilgım Apartmanı davasında, bilirkişi raporu gelmedi: Dava ertelendi
content:
Hatay'ın Antakya ilçesi Odabaşı Mahallesi'nde bulunan 3 yıllık Ilgım Apartmanı'nın 6 Şubat depremlerinde saniyeler içinde yıkılması nedeniyle en az 47 kişi hayatını kaybederken, 2 kişi yaralandı.

Hatay Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı, müteahhit ve şantiye şefi Salih Zorsu, yapı denetimi firması yetkilisi Edip Talipoğlu ve yapı denetim firması görevlileri Semir Yoldaş ile Ahmet Tatlı hakkında, "bilinçli taksirle ölüme ve yaralanmaya neden olma" suçundan dava açtı.

Hatay 5. Ağır Ceza Mahkemesi'nde haziran ayında görülen beşinci celsede, dosyanın re'sen seçilecek bilirkişi heyetine gönderilmesine karar verilerek duruşma 5 Kasım'a ertelenmişti.

Bilirkişi heyeti, duruşmaya 15 gün kala rapora ilişkin incelemeleri tamamlayabilmek için 30 günlük ek süre talebinde bulundu.

Bugün görülen 6'ncı celseye depremde yakınlarını kaybedenler ve taraf avukatları katıldı.

Mahkeme heyeti, bilirkişi raporunun beklenilmesine, kamu personelleri hakkındaki soruşturmanın akıbetinin sorulmasına ve müşteki avukatlarına sanıklara yöneltmek istedikleri soruları sunmaları için bir ay süre verilmesine karar verdi.

Bir sonraki duruşma 7 Ocak 2027'de görülecek.

Ilgım Apartmanı enkazında annesini, babasını ve kız kardeşini kaybeden müşteki avukatı Abdullah Eğilmez, süreci değerlendirdi:

“Dosyamızın bilirkişilere geç teslim edilmiş olması sebebiyle bugün görülen duruşmada esas yönünden bir ilerleme kaydedilememiştir. Bizler; ailelerini, canlarını ve sevdiklerini toprağa vermiş insanlar olarak, her duruşmada olduğu gibi bugün de bin kilometreyi aşan yolları geride bırakıp duruşma salonundaki yerimizi aldık. Ancak sanıklar, beklendiği üzere yine yoktu.

Sanık Salih Zorsu, bugüne kadar bir kez dahi duruşma salonunda huzurda bulunmadı. Yargılandığını dahi hissetmeyen, tahliyelerin ardından kutlamalar yapan sanıkların, kendi beyanlarından da anlaşıldığı üzere, bu yargılamayı yalnızca iş yapmalarına engel teşkil eden bir süreç olarak gördükleri ortadadır. Bizler, bu davanın sonunda cezasızlık algısının yıkıldığı, hakkaniyetli ve adil bir yargılama sonucunun ortaya çıktığı günleri bekliyoruz.

Bugün, yeni atanan ağır ceza mahkemesi başkanının dosyamızdaki ilk duruşmasıydı. Umuyoruz ki önceki başkan döneminde kaybettiğimiz zamanın telafisini bundan sonraki yargılama safhalarında görebiliriz. Bugüne kadar hissedemediğimiz adalet duygusunun karşılık bulmasını bekliyoruz. Artık sanıkların yokluğunun değil, sorumluların hesap verdiği bir yargılama görmek istiyoruz.”

author: Sam Rosenthal
title: Progressives in Congress Can Now Sway Funding, Investigations, Health Policy
content:
Progressives may soon have the best opportunity in decades to influence the direction of the Democratic Party.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

This week Donald Trump and the Republican Party suffered one of the most vehement repudiations of a sitting president in modern U.S. history. After the most expensive midterm election season ever, Democrats surged to take control of the House of Representatives and, more surprisingly, the Senate. They won seats in terrain that was previously thought well beyond the reach of the party: Senate seats in South Carolina, Kansas, Iowa, and Texas. Democratic candidates currently lead Senate races in Alaska and Mississippi as well. Even Texas’s longtime governor, Greg Abbott, was defeated by Democrat Gina Hinojosa, in a shocking upset that most prognosticators had not considered possible before Election Day.

With control of the House and Senate, Democrats will have vastly more power to counter President Donald Trump and his ultra-right-wing administration. How far the party is willing to go in combating Trump’s extremism, though, will be a function of both the tools available to the party and how vigorously members of the party push for confrontation with Trump.

Among the most potent tools Democrats will have in the next Congress will be the ability to conduct investigations with subpoena power. Investigations can be launched across different House and Senate committees, all of which will be chaired by Democrats, meaning that many investigations into the administration could run simultaneously. Democrats could, in effect, create an unending parade of public investigatory hearings that will drag Trump’s allies, inside and outside the administration, in front of TV cameras for interrogations. A prime target for congressional investigations could be Trump and his family’s dealings with cryptocurrency companies and foreign governments, which have drawn scrutiny for their barely disguised quid pro quo and pay-to-play arrangements.

Democrats will also have broad control over appropriations and sweeping discretion in how agencies across the federal government are funded. This opens the door to Democrats stripping significant resources from some of the policies that have come to define Trump’s second term, including funding for the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), which houses Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). DHS funding will run out in mid-December, before the new Congress is even seated. Democrats, who should feel emboldened by the midterm results, may take this opportunity to exert pressure on the Trump administration to enact ICE reforms. The administration could be more amenable to negotiating with Democrats now, when Republicans still hold majorities in Congress, rather than in a few months, when Democrats can pass legislation without Republicans’ input.

Unpopular foreign policy entanglements, like the war in Iran, could be upended by Democrats in the next Congress.

Unpopular foreign policy entanglements, like the war in Iran, could also be upended by Democrats in the next Congress. Democrats could pass another war powers resolution directing the administration to end U.S. hostilities with Iran, like the one that narrowly failed in September. They could also push to impeach Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth, an idea that’s gained momentum as the war in Iran has unraveled. Reporting in recent days has revealed that Trump, with prodding from Israel’s Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, has been seriously considering massive strikes on Iran in the days after the midterms. Both Trump and the Israeli government anticipate that the U.S.’s military incursions into Iran will become substantially harder to maintain after the new Congress is seated.

Democrats may also be more targeted in their efforts to push back against Trump’s corruption and bullying. Congressional Democrats have recently said they’re looking at ways they can throttle the administration’s sham investigation into Rep. Ilhan Omar’s citizenship status.

The number of card-carrying democratic socialists on the Democratic side of the aisle will increase, from two in the last session, to eight

The effectiveness of all of these strategies is, of course, dependent on how inclined Democrats are to play hardball with the administration. This is where the progressive bloc of representatives will have particular influence. As of the morning of November 5, the Congressional Progressive Caucus looks poised to have at least 105 members by the time the next Congress is seated, in January. That would be just over 40 percent of the approximately 255 seats that major news outlets are predicting Democrats will win. The number of card-carrying democratic socialists on the Democratic side of the aisle will also increase, from two in the last session, to eight in the next. This tension — between taking a measured approach and more bellicose confrontation — is likely to play out in internal debates between Democrats for the duration of the 120th Congress.

The raw numbers may understate the degree to which voters have swung left through 2026. Democrats running on unapologetically progressive programs won races far outside of the deep-blue urban districts that had, to this point, been the only areas where progressive candidates had found success. Candidates like Abdul El-Sayed won statewide in Michigan, a perennial purple state, where reams of outside spending and overt Islamophobia and racism failed to sink his campaign. El-Sayed ran on a promise to implement Medicare for All; even former President Barack Obama, no champion of single-payer health care, recently told voters that, in Congress, El-Sayed would “finish the job” his administration started by guaranteeing health care to all Americans.

In the last Congress, progressive voices were easier for the larger caucus to ignore. That is no longer the case.

Obama’s about-face on stumping for single-payer health care, to say nothing of his appearing with El-Sayed on the campaign trail while other Democrats actively undermined the latter’s campaign, speaks to the traction that El-Sayed’s brand of politics has with the Democratic electorate. In the last Congress, progressive voices were easier for the larger caucus to ignore. They were less numerous, and the popularity of many of their signature policies was untested with large parts of the Democratic base.

That is no longer the case. After a blockbuster primary season in which progressive candidates repeatedly bested moderate ones across the country, those same candidates have now shown that they can win in general elections, too. As the 120th Congress begins, then, progressives might have the best opportunity in decades to influence the direction of the party.

One topic sure to stir intra-caucus disagreement will be whether to pursue impeachment of Trump again. Progressives have been generally in favor of another impeachment proceeding, even though the high bar to conviction in the Senate means that Trump is unlikely to be removed from office. Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, for example, argued last year for impeaching Trump over his war with Iran, for which he did not seek congressional approval.

Democrats will still be constrained by the White House’s veto power, the reactionary Supreme Court, and the executive overreach that has become a hallmark of both Trump administrations.

Then, of course, progressives could pursue a more combative and confrontational course with their own party. Progressive activists and left-leaning members of Congress have so far been dissatisfied with Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries’s perceived inability to meaningfully challenge the Trump administration. Jeffries has protested that, without majorities in either chamber of Congress, and facing a Republican president with zero interest in bipartisan comity, his hands have been tied. With Jeffries now poised to lead the majority in the House, that will all change.

Axios reported recently that a group of progressive existing and soon-to-be members of Congress, informally dubbed “The Bloc,” are already thinking about how to push Jeffries to adopt more progressive policy. The Democrats’ blowout win might complicate progressives’ nascent plans to hold up Jeffries’s confirmation until they extract some concessions from him on their agenda. However, Jeffries will presumably want to display a united front across the party heading into the next Congress and progressives may use that leverage to extract promises from Jeffries that he’ll act on things like Medicare for All, defunding ICE, and halting weapons shipments to Israel — all parts of the progressive agenda that have caused major consternation among centrist Democrats.

Ultimately, Democrats will still be constrained by the White House’s veto power, the reactionary Supreme Court, and the executive overreach that has become a hallmark of both Trump administrations. Where progressives will have influence, though, will lie in their ability to push Democrats to do the most they can with what they have.

Truthout is funded almost entirely by readers — that’s why we can speak truth to power and cut against the mainstream narrative. But independent journalists at Truthout face mounting political repression under Trump.

We rely on your support to survive McCarthyist censorship. Please make a tax-deductible one-time or monthly donation.

title: Marmaris'te yol çöktü, sürücü uçuruma yuvarlandı
content:
Muğla'nın Marmaris ilçesine bağlı Armutalan Mahallesi'nde meydana gelen trafik kazasında bir kişi yaralandı.

Edinilen bilgiye göre, Armutalan Mahallesi'ndeki orman yolu üzerinde seyir halinde olan otomobil, yolun çökmesi sonucu kontrolden çıkarak uçuruma yan yattı.

Kazanın ardından araçtan uçuruma yuvarlanan yaşlı sürücü yaralanırken, olay yerine kurtarma ekipleri sevk edildi.

Kazanın ihbar edilmesi üzerine bölgeye Muğla Büyükşehir Belediyesi İtfaiye Daire Başkanlığı ekipleri ile SAR Arama Kurtarma ekipleri yönlendirildi.

Uçuruma yuvarlanarak mahsur kalan yaralı sürücüyü kurtarmak için ekipler çalışma başlattı.

Engebeli arazide gerçekleştirilen kurtarma operasyonunda itfaiye ve arama kurtarma ekipleri, araç içerisinde bulunan yaşlı sürücüye ulaşmayı başardı.

Ekiplerin ortak çalışması sonucunda uçurumdan çıkarılan yaralı sürücü, güvenli bölgeye taşınarak olay yerinde bekleyen sağlık ekiplerine teslim edildi.

İlk müdahalesi yapılan yaşlı sürücü, ambulansla Marmaris Devlet Hastanesine kaldırılarak tedavi altına alındı.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

title: Συγκεντρωσης αλληλεγγύης στα 8 συλληφθεντα της καταληψης Ροζα Νερα, Παρασκευή 6/11, στις 09.00, στα Δικαστήρια Χανίων
content:
Αφίσα/κάλεσμα από τη 

Κ

ατάληψη Rosa Nera

:







Ένοχοι είναι οι επενδυτές και το κράτος




Tην Παρασκευή 6 Νοεμβρίου, καλούνται να δικαστούν στα δικαστήρια Χανίων 8 σύντροφοι και συντρόφισσες που συνελήφθησαν από την αστυνομία κατά τη δεύτερη εκκένωση της κατάληψης Rosa Nera, στην 1 Απρίλη του 2024. Η βασικότερη κατηγορία που αντιμετωπίζουν άπαντες είναι αυτή της “διατάραξης οικιακής ειρήνης”, διότι τη στιγμή της αστυνομικής εισβολής στον χώρο βρέθηκαν να διαμένουν στο κτήριο.


Υπενθυμίζουμε πως τότε, τον Απρίλη του 2024, η αστυνομία εκκενώνει για δεύτερη φορά την κατάληψη. Η πρώτη εκκένωση πραγματοποιήθηκε τον Σεπτέμβρη του 2020, και για εννέα μήνες ο αύλειος χώρος όπως και το κτήριο της Rosa Nera παρέμεναν ερμητικά κλειστά και φυλασσόμενα επί εικοσιτετραώρου βάσεως από μπάτσους. Μέχρι που το τοπικό κίνημα αλληλεγγύης στην κατάληψη, έπειτα από έναν πολύμηνο αγώνα,


ανακατέλαβε το κτήριο και άνοιξε την αυλή, δίνοντας έτσι ξανά κοινωνική πρόσβαση στο αυτοδιαχειριζόμενο “μπαλκόνι των Χανίων”. Στο δικαστήριο της πρώτης εκκένωσης, που πραγματοποιήθηκε έναν χρόνο μετά, και στο οποίο οι σύντροφοι αντιμετώπιζαν βαρύτερες


κατηγορίες, όπως η “φθορά μνημείου”, αθωώθηκαν αφού απαλλάχτηκαν από την κατηγορία, υποστηρίζοντας πως με την παρουσία και την δράση τους, όχι μόνο δεν έφθειραν το μνημείο, αλλά συνέβαλλαν στη διάσωση και συντήρηση του, έτσι ώστε να καλύπτει ανοιχτές κοινωνικές και πολιτικές ανάγκες.


Ο αγώνας ενάντια στην ξενοδοχοποίηση των κτηρίων στο λόφο Καστέλι συσπείρωσε σημαντικά κοινωνικά κομμάτια και στάθηκε νικηφόρος απέναντι στις ορέξεις των επενδυτών, οι οποίοι όμως δεν πτοήθηκαν. Έτσι, το πρωινό της 1ης Απρίλη του 2024, οι μπάτσοι συλλαμβάνουν τους 7 συντρόφους και συντρόφισσες μας, παραδίδοντας το κτήριο σε συνεργεία εργολάβων και στην τοπική εφορεία αρχαιοτήτων, με σκοπό να προχωρήσουν σε μια σειρά δειγματοληπτικών και διερευνητικών εργασιών, τόσο μέσα στο κτήριο όσο και έξω από αυτό, ούτως ώστε η εταιρία να ολοκληρώσει τον φάκελο αδειοδότησης του πρότζεκτ της, καταθέτοντας τον εν συνεχεία στο ΚΑΣ για έγκριση.


Και σ’ αυτή την περίπτωση της εκκένωσης της κατάληψης, το κτήριο ανακαταλήφθηκε μετά από τρεις εβδομάδες φύλαξης του από την αστυνομία και μετά από κινητοποιήσεις του τοπικού κινήματος. Μάλιστα, ήταν τέτοιο το μένος των ασφαλιτών απέναντι στην κατάληψη, που κατά την αποχώρηση τους φρόντισαν να τα κάνουν όλα “γης μαδιάμ”,


καταστρέφοντας κινηματικές υποδομές, χώρους στέγασης και φιλοξενίας, βάφοντας τους τοίχους με οπαδικού χαρακτήρα συνθήματα και βανδαλίζοντας ό,τι έβρισκαν μπροστά τους, φτάνοντας στο σημείο να ουρούν και να αφοδεύουν πάνω στα στρώματα και να αδειάζουν πυροσβεστήρες στα δωμάτια. Τα δε συνεργεία του εργολάβου, αφού πήραν τα πολυπόθητα δείγματα από τους χώρους του κτηρίου, δεν φρόντισαν για την αποκατάσταση, αφήνοντας παντού διαμπερείς τρύπες, καροτιές πάνω σε κολώνες και πατώματα, χωρίς καν να μπουν στον κόπο να ρίξουν έστω λίγο τσιμέντο. Αυτός ήταν ο περιβόητος σεβασμός απέναντι στο μνημείο από την πλευρά του κράτους και των επενδυτών.


Στον αντίποδα όμως της καταστροφικής μανίας του κόσμου της εξουσίας βρίσκεται ο κόσμος αυτών που επιμένουν να παλεύουν και να δημιουργούν. Και μέσα σε αυτόν τον κόσμο βρίσκονται και οι 8 κατηγορούμενοι/ες που καλούνται να δικαστούν στις 6 Νοεμβρίου. Γιατί μέσα από την διαμονή τους στην κατάληψη κάλυπταν τις στεγαστικές


τους ανάγκες σε μια πόλη που τα σπίτια είναι δυσεύρετα και τα ενοίκια στον θεό. Γιατί είναι από αυτούς και αυτές που μαζί με τον κόσμο του κινήματος επιδιόρθωσαν τις ζημιές στο κτήριο, στηριζόμενοι αποκλειστικά στις ίδιες τους τις αξίες και τις δυνάμεις.


Στα 23 χρόνια της ύπαρξης της, η Rosa Nera κάλυπτε και καλύπτει έναν αστερισμό αναγκών, αυτοοργανωμένα και αντιεμπορευματικά, μεταξύ των οποίων και η στέγαση.




Στους χώρους της έχει φιλοξενήσει εκατοντάδες ανθρώπους, είτε για μια νύχτα είτε για μεγαλύτερο χρονικό διάστημα. Ανθρώπους οι οποίοι ήταν αόρατοι και αποκλεισμένοι από το κράτος, αφού δεν είχαν χαρτιά ή λεφτά. Ανθρώπους συμμέτοχους στον πολιτικό αγώνα που μέσα από τις δράσεις και τη συμμετοχή τους στη συνέλευση της κατάληψης κρατούσαν τον χώρο προσβάσιμο για όλη την κοινωνία, χωρίς αντίτιμο. Η επερχόμενη δίκη μπορεί να δικάζει τους συγκεκριμένους 8 κατηγορούμενους που έτυχε να βρεθούν τη συγκεκριμένη ημέρα και ώρα μέσα στο κτήριο, αλλά ουσιαστικά δικάζει όλον αυτόν τον κόσμο -κινηματικό ή μη- ο οποίος έχει διαμείνει στο κτήριο, έχει περάσει από τις εκδηλώσεις της κατάληψης και έχει δώσει το παρόν σε πορείες υπεράσπισης, δράσεις και πολιτιστικές της εκδηλώσεις. Δικάζει όλο το τοπικό κίνημα υπεράσπισης.


Είναι σε όλους γνωστό πως η ίδια η ύπαρξη της Rosa Nera και η επιμονή των συντροφισσών και των συντρόφων ήταν που έβαζαν φρένο στην εταιρία Belvedere, απέναντι σε οποιαδήποτε ξενοδοχειακή αξιοποίηση και εμπορευματική περίφραξη του λόφου Καστέλι. Ακόμα κι αν εν τέλει, η εταιρία έφαγε τα μούτρα της στην εν λόγω συνεδρίαση του ΚΑΣ και η αίτηση της δεν συζητήθηκε καν, ακόμα κι αν αποσύρθηκε από την επένδυση εκτιμώντας πως το πράγμα δεν προχωράει, έπειτα και από το νικηφόροcαγώνα του κινήματος, η απειλή καταστολής της κατάληψης δεν έχει φύγει οριστικά από τονcορίζοντα. Aυτή τη φορά ή “αξιοποίηση” της κατάληψης πάει να μας σερβιριστεί ως “βιώσιμη ανάπτυξη”, ως “πολιτιστική και εκπαιδευτική συνάντηση” και άλλα τέτοια αόριστα


και συναφή, τα οποία βεβαίως αποκρύπτουν το κύριο επίδικο: ότι αυτός ο χώρος 23 χρόνια τώρα αξιοποιείται από την κατάληψη Rosa Nera, με τρόπο αντιεμπορευματικό και από τα κάτω, δίνοντας πρόσβαση σε όλους αυτούς και όλες αυτές που δεν χωράνε στα ασφυκτικά πλαίσια μιας πόλης τουριστικής ατραξιόν. Αξιοποιείται με έναν πολιτισμό, πολύ


μακριά από τον δικό τους, χωρίς να μας αποφέρει κέρδος και χωρίς να συμμετέχουμε στο πανηγυράκι που έχουν στήσει ντόπιοι ξενοδόχοι, αφεντικά του τουρισμού και διάφοροι εργολάβοι που περιμένουν στη γωνία.


Σε μια πόλη που διαρκώς μεταβάλλεται για να καλύπτει τις ανάγκες του τουριστικούcκεφαλαίου, σε μια πόλη που η τουριστική ανάπτυξη εκτοπίζει τους κατοίκους της, η κατάληψη αποτελεί παραφωνία. Γιατί επιμένει να αποτελεί έναν χώρο συνάντησης κοινωνικών και ταξικών αγώνων απέναντι σε όλα τα παραπάνω. Γιατί επιλέγει να βγάζει


λόγο ενάντια σε όλο αυτό το πλέγμα εξουσίας πρυτάνεων, δήμου και κυβέρνησης που πάνε να μας πουλήσουν το παραμύθι της “κοινωνικής αξιοποίησης ” του χώρου, παράλληλα με το αφήγημα της συμμετοχής των πολιτών στις αποφάσεις. Γιατί αντιλαμβανόμαστε την κατάληψη ως έναν χώρο δημιουργίας και αγώνων, ως ένα κομμάτι από την ίδια μας τη ζωή, χωρίς τις διαμεσολαβήσεις κράτους και εμπορεύματος. Και ξέρουμε πως και οι σύντροφοι και συντρόφισσες που δικάζονται στις 6 Νοέμβρη το αντιλαμβάνονται με τον ίδιο τρόπο. Για αυτό και είναι αθώοι.




Ο,ΤΙ ΞΕΡΑΜΕ ΚΑΙ ΞΕΡΑΤΕ ΙΣΧΥΕΙ. Η ROSA NERA KATΑΛΗΨΗ ΘΑ ΜΕΙΝΕΙ


KAMMIA ΔΙΩΞΗ ΣΤΟΥΣ/ΣΤΙΣ 8 ΚΑΤΑΛΗΨΙΕΣ ΤΗΣ ROSA NERA


ΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΚΑ ΕΝΟΧΟΙ ΟΙ ΕΠΕΝΔΥΤΕΣ ΚΑΙ ΤΟ ΚΡΑΤΟΣ




ΣΥΓΚΕΝΤΡΩΣΗ ΑΛΛΗΛΕΓΓΥΗΣ, ΤΗΝ ΠΑΡΑΣΚΕΥΗ 06/11 | 9 :00 | ΣΤΑ ΔΙΚΑΣΤΗΡΙΑ ΧΑΝΙΩΝ







Καλεσμα συγκεντρωσης αλληλεγγύης στα 8 συλληφθεντα της καταληψης Ροζα Νερα




Καλουμε σε συγκεντρωση αλληλεγγυης εξω απο τα δικαστηρια Χανιων την Παρασκευη 6/11 στις 09:00 για τα 8 ατομα της καταληψης Ροζα Νερα που συνεληφθησαν επειτα απο την 2η εκκενωση του λοφου Καστελι που πραγματοποιηθηκε την 1 Απριλιου του 2024.







ΚΑΤΩ ΤΑ ΧΕΡΙΑ ΑΠΟ ΤΟΝ ΚΑΤΕΙΛΗΜΜΕΝΟ ΛΟΦΟ ΚΑΣΤΕΛΙ




ΚΑΜΙΑ ΔΙΩΞΗ ΣΤΑ 8 ΣΥΛΛΗΦΘΕΝΤΑ










Δήλωση συμπαράστασης στη Rosa Nera από τη θεατρική ομάδα “Ανάμεσα στο Φως και τη Σκιά”:







Δήλωση συμπαράστασης στη Rosa Nera




Η artistic performance team Ανάμεσα στο Φως και τη Σκιά ως θεατρική ομάδα που έχει κατά καιρούς φιλοξενηθεί στον χώρο του θεάτρου της κατάληψης Rosa Nera για την παρουσίαση παραστάσεών της, εκφράζουμε την αλληλεγγύη και τη συμπαράστασή μας στους/στις οκτώ διωκόμενους/ες, οι οποίοι/ες καλούνται να αντιμετωπίσουν τη δικαστική διαδικασία με την κατηγορία της «διατάραξης οικιακής ειρήνης».




Η αστυνομική επέμβαση της 1ης Απριλίου 2024 στον χώρο της Rosa Nera, η οποία οδήγησε στη σύλληψη οκτώ ατόμων, αποτελεί ένα γεγονός. Παράλληλα, το διάστημα κατά το οποίο ο χώρος βρισκόταν υπό αστυνομικό αποκλεισμό, καταγγέλθηκαν περιστατικά φθορών και βανδαλισμών στο κτήριο, για τα οποία υπάρχουν μαρτυρίες και φωτογραφικό υλικό. Η αντίφαση ανάμεσα στη δίωξη των ανθρώπων που φρόντιζαν και διατηρούσαν τον χώρο και στην απουσία αντίστοιχης λογοδοσίας για τις καταγγελλόμενες φθορές αναδεικνύει ζητήματα που μας προβληματίζουν βαθιά.




Η Rosa Nera αποτελεί έναν χώρο που, μέσα από τη συλλογική δράση και την αυτοοργάνωση, έχει συμβάλει ουσιαστικά στην πολιτιστική και κοινωνική ζωή της πόλης των Χανίων. Έναν χώρο που φιλοξενεί καλλιτεχνικές δημιουργίες, θεατρικές παραστάσεις, συζητήσεις και δράσεις, προσφέροντας δυνατότητες έκφρασης, συμμετοχής και συνάντησης, χωρίς αποκλεισμούς και οικονομικά εμπόδια.




Για εμάς, η δυνατότητα παρουσίασης των θεατρικών μας έργων σε έναν τέτοιο χώρο αποτελεί σημαντική εμπειρία και έμπρακτη αναγνώριση της αξίας της ανεξάρτητης καλλιτεχνικής δημιουργίας. Η ελεύθερη πρόσβαση στον πολιτισμό, η συλλογική έκφραση και η ύπαρξη χώρων που δεν υπαγορεύονται από τη λογική της εμπορευματοποίησης είναι ζητήματα που μας αφορούν άμεσα.




Η δικαστική δίωξη των ανθρώπων που συνέβαλαν στη διατήρηση και τη λειτουργία της Rosa Nera δεν μπορεί να μας αφήσει αδιάφορους. Η υπεράσπιση των ελεύθερων χώρων πολιτισμού και κοινωνικής συνάντησης, ιδιαίτερα σε μια πόλη που βιώνει ολοένα εντονότερα τις συνέπειες της υπερτουριστικοποίησης, αποτελεί ζήτημα συλλογικής ευθύνης.




Στεκόμαστε αλληλέγγυοι/ες στους/στις διωκόμενους/ες και υπερασπιζόμαστε το δικαίωμα στην ελεύθερη πολιτιστική έκφραση, στη συλλογική δημιουργία και στην ύπαρξη χώρων ανοιχτών στην κοινωνία.




Καλούμε όλες και όλους να εκφράσουν έμπρακτα τη συμπαράστασή τους και να παρευρεθούν στο δικαστήριο την Παρασκευή 6 Νοεμβρίου.




Η υπεράσπιση της Rosa Nera είναι και υπεράσπιση της δυνατότητας να δημιουργούμε, να συναντιόμαστε και να συνυπάρχουμε σε μια πόλη που ανήκει στους ανθρώπους της.




* εικόνες από παρουσιάσεις της ομάδας στην Rosa Nera.
