HKCTU leitet Selbstauflösung ein




„

In den letzten Monaten war der Gewerkschaftsbund Hongkong Confederation of Trade Unions (HKCTU) Angriffen der staatlichen Medien ausgesetzt. Zusammen mit den Ereignissen bei der Civil Human Rights Front, der Hong Kong Professional Teachers Union, der Hong Kong Alliance in Support of Patriotic Democratic Movements of China usw. haben sich die Mitglieder des HKCTU auf ein neues Klima eingestellt, in dem es für den HKCTU keinen Platz mehr gibt.




Keine andere Wahl, als die Auflösung einzuleiten, nachdem die persönliche Sicherheit von Funktionsträgern bedroht wurde




In den letzten Wochen haben einige HKCTU-Mitglieder nach und nach weitere Informationen erhalten, die uns das Gefühl vermitteln, dass die Aufrechterhaltung des HKCTU die persönliche Sicherheit dieser Mitglieder bedrohen könnte. Da dieses Problem aus der Existenz des HKCTU resultiert, ist der Rücktritt einzelner Amtsträger einfach keine Lösung. In Anbetracht der möglichen Risiken und Kosten, die für die Mitglieder entstehen können, wenn Hongkong City Telecommunications Union (HKCTU) weiterbesteht, und nach eingehender Erörterung ist die HKCTU der Ansicht, dass die derzeitigen Risiken und Perspektiven den Mitgliedsorganisationen lediglich zur Beratung und Beschlussfassung über die Zukunft der Organisation auf der Generalversammlung vorgelegt werden sollten.




Auf der Sitzung des Vorstands am Donnerstag, dem 16. September, wurde beschlossen, den Auflösungsprozess einzuleiten und auf der Generalversammlung einen Auflösungsantrag zu stellen. In der Zwischenzeit wurde ein auf gegenseitigem Vertrauen und Solidarität beruhender Konsens erzielt, wonach nur noch der Vorsitzende WONG Nai-yuen, der stellvertretende Vorsitzende TANG Kin-wa und der Schatzmeister CHUNG Chung-fai verbleiben, um den Rest des Prozesses durchzuführen; die übrigen Vorstandsmitglieder schieden aus dem Amt aus. Am Freitagabend wurden die Mitglieder über eine außerordentliche Generalversammlung informiert, die am 3. Oktober stattfinden soll, um die Auflösung zu diskutieren und zu beschließen. Die monatlichen Zuwendungen und die Hotline für arbeitsrechtliche Fragen werden mit sofortiger Wirkung eingestellt, und es werden keine weiteren Fälle von Arbeitskonflikten für die angeschlossenen Gewerkschaften entgegengenommen. Der HKCTU berät sich mit den Mitgliedsorganisationen über die bereits eingegangenen Fälle, um die Unannehmlichkeiten so gering wie möglich zu halten.




Streikrecht und Vereinigungsfreiheit durch Unterstellung durch Staatsmedien bedroht mit dem Vorwurf der Kollaboration mit ausländischen Kräften




Der HKCTU wurde von Wenweipo beschuldigt, mit ausländischen Mächten gemeinsame Sache zu machen und sich mit dem Internationalen Gewerkschaftsbund (IGB) auszutauschen, einer „politischen Organisation im Gewand einer internationalen Gewerkschaft“. Tatsächlich ist der IGB jedoch der größte globale Gewerkschaftsbund und vertritt 332 Gewerkschaftsorganisationen aus 163 Ländern und Regionen.




„Dies sind gemeinsame Verbindungen zwischen Gewerkschaften in der internationalen Zivilgesellschaft, so dass wir einer solchen politischen Diskreditierung als so genannter ausländischer Agent in keiner Weise zustimmen“, sagte Wong, „Arbeiterbewegungen haben schon immer auf internationale Solidarität gesetzt, so dass es für den HKCTU vernünftig und natürlich ist, mit Gewerkschaften in verschiedenen Regionen zusammenzuarbeiten und Kontakt aufzunehmen. In den letzten 30 Jahren hat die Regierung nie behauptet, dass dies ungesetzlich sei. Es ist eine Bedrohung für das Recht der Beschäftigten, einer Gewerkschaft beizutreten, wenn die Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Gewerkschaften als geheime Absprache mit ausländischen Kräften angesehen wird. Er stellte sich auch die Frage: „Wir können den Vorwurf der Anstiftung zum Streik, zur Gründung neuer Gewerkschaften usw. nicht verstehen. Es ist ein durch das Grundgesetz geschütztes Grundrecht, eine Gewerkschaft zu gründen und einen Streik zu führen. Warum wird daraus plötzlich ein Verbrechen? Ist es so, dass Gewerkschaften, die nicht auf der Seite des Establishments stehen, eine Erbsünde tragen?“




Dank an LEE Cheuk-yan und Carol NG und Entschuldigung bei den Mitgliedsorganisationen und der Bevölkerung von Hongkong




Wong würdigte im Namen des HKCTU den Generalsekretär LEE Cheuk-yan und die ehemalige Vorsitzende Carol NG für ihren enormen Beitrag für die Gewerkschaft und die Bewegung. Er sagte: „Auch wenn sie nicht anwesend sind, bin ich sicher, dass ihre Gedanken immer noch bei uns sind.“ Er dankte auch den angeschlossenen Gewerkschaften, den ehemaligen Vorstandsmitgliedern, den Mitarbeitern, den Freiwilligen und der Öffentlichkeit für ihr Engagement und ihre Unterstützung. Er entschuldigte sich auch bei den Mitgliedsorganisationen und der Öffentlichkeit: „Es tut mir leid, HKCTU kann nicht länger bestehen.“




„Eine Bewegung kann Rückschläge und Antriebsschwächen erleben, aber wir glauben immer daran, dass Solidarität die Kraft ist“, sagte Wong, „die 31-jährige Geschichte des HKCTU war Zeuge des Aufstiegs und Falls der Hongkonger Gesellschaft. Er entstand aufgrund einer großen Bewegung und ging auch aufgrund einer großen Bewegung zu Ende. Solange es jedoch Arbeitnehmer gibt und die sozialen Konflikte schwerwiegend bleiben, wird sich die Arbeiterbewegung mit Sicherheit weiterentwickeln. Die Werte und der Geist der Solidarität des HKCTU werden nicht verschwinden, die Zeit wird zeigen, dass wir alle Herausforderungen dieser Zeit meistern werden. Wir hoffen, dass die bisherigen Bemühungen des HKCTU als historische Ressourcen dienen, die die Gewerkschaftsbewegung in Zukunft weiterbringen wird. Wir wünschen uns für die nahe Zukunft solidere und lebendigere Früchte der Arbeiterbewegung in Hongkong. Verwelkte Blumen sind keine nutzlosen Blumen; wenn sie im Frühling zu Erde werden, nähren sie weitere Blumen“.




An dieser Stelle möchten wir auch der weltweiten Leserschaft unserer E-Newsletter für ihr langes Abonnement und Interesse danken. Wir sind stolz darauf, dass wir im Laufe der Jahrzehnte mit allen Gewerkschaften und Gewerkschaftsgruppen auf dem Weg der Arbeiterbewegung zusammenarbeiten konnten, und wir sind gerührt von all der solidarischen Unterstützung, die wir einander gegeben haben. Auf bald, und bleibt stark!

Außerdem haben die Behörden Mitte August mitgeteilt, dass sie die Eintragung der GUHKST mit der Begründung widerrufen haben, dass „die Gewerkschaft für ungesetzliche oder mit ihren Zielen oder Regeln unvereinbare Zwecke verwendet wird“. Lorie Lai schreibt am 4.8.21 (dem 12. Tag ihrer Untersuchungshaft) schreibt sie u.a.: „… 

Denkt daran, auch im Gefängnis einen klaren Kopf zu behalten. Das Gefährliche ist, dass man, sobald man sich daran gewöhnt hat, nicht mehr zu denken, auch den Kampf und die Verteidigung der eigenen Rechte aufgeben wird. Auch wenn die Chancen in Hongkong heute immer schlechter stehen, hat unsere Geisteshaltung einen Einfluss darauf, wie wir die Gesellschaft und die Realität wahrnehmen. Unser Körper kann gefangen gehalten werden, aber unser Geist wird immer frei sein. Ich hoffe, dass wir alle an unserem Glauben festhalten und ausharren können

…“ Siehe den ganzen 

Brief in englischer Übersetzung beim International Labour Network of Solidarity and Struggles

 




Hongkongs größte Lehrergewerkschaft Professional Teachers‘ Union (HKPTU) hat auf Druck der Regierung ihre Auflösung und den Austritt aus dem Gewerkschaftsbund bekannt gegeben 




„

Hongkongs größte Lehrergewerkschaft soll auf Druck der Regierung und der chinesischen Staatsmedien aufgelöst werden. Die 1973 gegründete Gewerkschaft wurde von der chinesischen Staatszeitung People’s Daily und der Nachrichtenagentur Xinhua als „giftiger Tumor“ bezeichnet, der „ausgerottet“ werden müsse. Die HKPTU war mit über 95.000 Mitgliedern die größte Lehrergewerkschaft der Stadt und vertrat über 90 Prozent der Lehrerschaft. Dies geschah, nachdem das Bildungsministerium am 31. Juli seine Entscheidung bekannt gegeben hatte, alle Verbindungen zu der Gewerkschaft abzubrechen – wenige Stunden nachdem die Gruppe in den chinesischen Staatsmedien unter Beschuss geraten war. (…) „Wir haben einen enormen Druck verspürt“, sagte der HKPTU-Präsident Fung Wai-wah am Dienstag auf einer Pressekonferenz vor Journalisten. „Wir verstehen, dass viele Mitglieder eine tiefe Verbundenheit mit der Gewerkschaft haben und traurig über die Auflösung der HKPTU sind“. (…) Nach der Erklärung der Regierung trat die 48-jährige Gewerkschaft aus dem pro-demokratischen Gewerkschaftsbund Hongkong Confederation of Trade Unions und der Education International, einem weltweiten Netzwerk von Erziehergewerkschaften, aus. Die HKPTU versprach außerdem, sich nach der Entscheidung der Regierung „auf die Rechte und Interessen des Bildungssektors“ zu konzentrieren, und hatte einen Arbeitsausschuss zur Förderung der chinesischen Geschichte und Kultur eingerichtet, um die „Zuneigung zu Heimat und Land“ unter den Studenten zu fördern

…“ Aus dem (engl.) 

Artikel von Candice Chau vom 10. August 2021 in der Hong Kong Free Press online

 

, siehe die HKCTU-Erklärung dazu:







Die Zivilgesellschaft im Fokus. Erklärungen von Gewerkschaften und Organisationen zur Zerschlagung der Lehrergewerkschaft










Solidaritätserklärungen der Education International, von Amnesty International und Hong Kong Journalists Association (HKJA) („Wir könnten die nächsten sein, aber wir werden weitermachen“) – 

die Entwicklungen der letzten Tage in Pressemeldungen übersetzt am 18. August 2021 beim Forum Arbeitswelten

 

, siehe insbesondere:




Medien der KPCh verhängen Todesurteil gegen Lehrergewerkschaft: Der Rechtsstaat in Hongkong ist tot, aber nicht der Widerstand




„

Trotz ihrer Rhetorik über die Aufrechterhaltung der Rechtsstaatlichkeit gibt es keine Organisation in China, die dem Rechtsstaat mehr schadet als die Komunistische Partei. Das Sprachrohr der Partei, die Volkszeitung, veröffentlichte einen Kommentar, in dem sie Hongkongs größte Gewerkschaft – die Professional Teachers‘ Union (PTU) – vorwarf, „anti-chinesische Aktivitäten zu fördern, die Hongkong durcheinander bringen“ und somit ein „Tumor sei, der ausgemerzt werden müsste“. Angesichts dieser erfundenen Anschuldigungen staatlicher Medien kündigte das Bildungsministerium der Regierung von Hongkong an, die PTU nicht mehr als Berufsorganisation anzuerkennen, und deutete an, dass Lehrer nicht ihre Mitglieder sein sollten. Diese Schritte im Rahmen des seit über einem Jahr geltenden Nationalen Sicherheitsgesetzes haben die Oppositionellen bereits kriminalisiert und die PTU zu der Entscheidung gezwungen, sich am 10. August 2021 aufzulösen. Dies ist eine große Niederlage sowohl für Hongkongs Zivilgesellschaft als auch die Arbeiterbewegung, die eine der Säulen der demokratischen Bewegung Hongkongs war

…“ 

Übersetzung von Peter Franke

 

 

 beim Forum Arbeitswelten der 

Erklärung von Borderless Movement

 

, Hongkong, vom 12. August, 2021










Eine 48 Jahre alte Gewerkschaft in nur 11 Tagen verschwunden – wie Hongkonger Lehrer eine starke Stimme verloren haben  


„

48 Jahre erhob die Lehrergewerkschaft Hong Kong Professional Teachers‘ Union 

(HKPTU) ihre Stimme für Lehrende und zu politische Fragen – doch das Ende kam 

brutal schnell. Die Entscheidung der pro-demokratischen Hong Kong Professional Teachers’ Union (HKPTU), unter Berufung auf den „enormen Druck“ von Peking und der Stadtregierung sich nach 48 Jahren aufzulösen, hat eine wichtige Stimme der Zivilgesellschaft zum Schweigen gebracht. (…) Die Gewerkschaft, die über 90 Prozent der Lehrenden der Stadt vertrat, hatte sich traditionell für bessere Arbeitsbedingungen für LehrerInnen, für schülerorientierte Bildungsreformen und für eine umfassendere Demokratie für die Stadt eingesetzt. Die Schließung wird sich nachhaltig auf das tägliche Leben der ehemaligen Mitglieder auswirken, die nun keinen Zugang mehr zu den umfassenden Sozialleistungen und Vergünstigungen haben, die die Gewerkschaft jahrzehntelang gewährt hat. Diese reichten von Versicherungen, Rechts- und Fachberatungen über Arzt- und Zahnkliniken bis hin zu Discountläden und  Reiseangeboten. Sie macht auch ihre 200 MitarbeiterInnen arbeitslos. Hong Kong Free Press zeichnet die Geschichte der Gewerkschaft bei der Unterstützung und 

Verteidigung der Rechte von LehrerInnen und ihre Stellungnahmen zu politischen Themen von der Kolonialzeit bis zur Übergabe (an die VR China d.Ü.) und Pekings nationalem Sicherheitsgesetz wie folgt nach

…“ 

Übersetzung durch Peter Franke

 

 

 beim Forum Arbeitswelten – China und Deutschland – des Artikels „A 48-year-old union gone in 11 days – how Hong Kong teachers lost a powerful voice“ 

von Rhoda Kwan am 15. August 2021 in der Hong Kong Free Press online

 




HKCTU-Erklärung als Reaktion auf die Entscheidung der HKPTU, sich aufzulösen


„

Die Hong Kong Professional Teachers‘ Union (HKPTU) hat heute ihre Entscheidung bekannt gegeben, sich aufzulösen. Die HKPTU stand in letzter Zeit unter enormem politischem Druck, bevor sie zu dieser Entscheidung kam, die wir verstehen und respektieren. Zu den anhaltenden Angriffen auf die HKPTU gehören die politische Einschüchterung durch die staatlichen Medien sowie die rücksichtslose Beendigung der Partnerschaft durch das Bildungsbüro in den letzten Wochen. Die ständigen Angriffe führten schließlich zur erzwungenen Auflösung der HKPTU, die dem staatlichen Eingriff in die Vereinigungsfreiheit zum Opfer fiel. Die erzwungene Auflösung der HKPTU ist zweifellos ein drastischer Schaden für die Förderung der Rechte der Lehrer, da der Bildungssektor die repräsentativste Organisation verliert, die für die Rechte der Lehrer eintreten kann. Die anhaltende Beschneidung der Freiheiten in der Zivilgesellschaft und die beängstigende Atmosphäre in der Gesellschaft schaden der Gewerkschaftsbewegung definitiv. Die Arbeiterbewegung hatte es nie leicht, und die Zukunft ist noch schwieriger. Angesichts solcher Widrigkeiten bleibt der Hongkonger Gewerkschaftsbund in seiner Position und spricht weiterhin für die Arbeitnehmer

…“ Aus der HKCTU-Erklärung 

auf Englisch dokumentiert am 10 August 2021 bei laboursolidarity.org

 










Massive Angriffe auf die Gewerkschaftsbewegung Hongkongs: Ein Aufruf zur Solidarität: Verteidigt die HKPTU – verteidigt die Hongkonger Lehrer!  

„

In diesem Blog wurde bereits wiederholt über Repression gegen Gewerkschaften und Gewerkschafter berichtet. Diese Politik setzt sich fort und zielt auf die vollständige Unterwerfung, bzw. Zerschlagung der Gewerkschaften. Auch die Studentenvertretungen sind ein Ziel der staatlichen Angriffe (…) Es werden gleichzeitig die Organisationen der Beschäftigten angegriffen, aktuell die Lehrergewerkschaft PTU. Die 1974 gegründete größte Einzelberufsgewerkschaft Hongkongs gilt als die letzte verbliebene Hochburg der Oppositionsbewegung. Staatliche Medien griffen am Samstag die Hong Kong Professional Teachers‘ Union an und bezeichneten die pro-demokratische Organisation als einen Tumor, der beseitigt werden müsse. In einem Artikel der People’s Daily hieß es, die Gewerkschaft stehe gegen Bildung und Professionalität und fördere antichinesische Aktivitäten, die Hongkong in den Ruin treiben. Sie beschuldigte die Gewerkschaft, Lehrer zu ermutigen, Unruhe zu stiften und Kinder zu lehren, gegen Gesetze zu verstoßen. (…) „Damit das Hongkonger Bildungswesen wieder auf den richtigen Weg kommt, muss die Lehrergewerkschaft untersucht und der Tumor beseitigt werden“, hieß es in dem Xinhua-Artikel. Bildungsbüro kappt Beziehungen zu Hongkongs größter Lehrergewerkschaft, Stunden nachdem chinesische Staatsmedien die Organisation als „bösartigen Tumor“ bezeichnet haben (…) Zahlreiche Aktivisten sind aus Hongkong nach Groß Britannien geflüchtet. Sie bilden gemeinsam mit britischen Gewerkschaftern das Labour Movement Solidarity with Hong Kong (UK) und stellen eine wichtige Stimme in Kampf für die Rechte der Lohnabhängigen dar, nicht nur in Hongkong. In London haben sie zu einem Protest vor dem britischen Innenministerium am 29.7. aufgerufen, bei dem es sowohl um den Umgang der britischen Regierung mit Geflüchteten, als auch um die Solidarität mit den Arbeitern und unterdrückten Menschen in China ging

…“ 

Übersetzungen aus diversen Medien am 5.8.2021 beim Forum Arbeitswelten

 

 und darin der Aufruf „

Verteidigt die HKPTU – verteidigt die Hongkonger Lehrer!

“ mit einem Online-Formular zum Mitzeichnen der Erklärung: „

Wir protestieren mit diesem Schreiben gegen die Nichtanerkennung der Hong Kong Professional Teachers‘ Union (HKPTU) durch die Regierung von Hongkong und gegen ihre allgemeinen Angriffe auf Gewerkschafter

…“




siehe auch beim Forum Arbeitswelten 

die Besprechung einer Untersuchung des Arbeiteraktivismus in China

author: Anne-Marie Cicala
title: How My Body Rejected Lithium After 25 Years
content:
It was two o’clock in the morning on our first night out of town in New Orleans, and I woke up suddenly in the dark hotel room feeling horribly sick and needing to run to the bathroom. What ensued was messy and lasted for two hours. I kept waking up with my head in the toilet to do it again. I used most of the towels in the bathroom to clean up both myself and the mess I had made on the floor. At 4am, exhausted and beyond tired, not knowing exactly how to handle the situation, I opened my hotel room door completely naked, threw the armful of soiled towels into the hallway and went back to bed.

The next morning, I woke up extremely nauseous. I was thankful we had packed a decent amount of THC gummies, as they proved to be a savior for the next few days. The gummies took the nausea down to a level where I was able to function throughout the day, but I was still not feeling right or well. I didn’t know if it was from the previous night’s events, but I felt subdued by a heavy brain fog.

The day progressed slowly, as I was not feeling 100%, but I made it through, enduring other would just get a good night’s sleep and be better in the morning. Yet, without fail, I once more woke up in the middle of the night, more prepared this time, and got sick several times.

I really had no idea what was going on. Once again, I woke up with severe nausea but thought maybe a good breakfast would set me straight.

At the hotel restaurant, I could not tolerate the smell of the food. I could barely drink my coffee. My husband, looking at me searchingly, kept asking if I was okay. I tried to assure him that I would be fine, although I wasn’t sure I believed that myself. He finally said, “I don’t know what to do when my wife looks like she’s about to vomit at any moment.” Remembering how much the gummies had helped me the day before, I decided it was going to have to be another day like that, so I asked him to go up to the room to retrieve one for me. He happily obliged. I ate the gummy and was feeling relief within about 40 minutes. I could finally breathe and begin to perform as a person on vacation.

At restaurants, I noticed that the menus would shake furiously in my hands, as well as my fork and my drinking glass. I brushed it off as my usual lithium tremor combined with low blood sugar. I also noticed that my thirst was unquenchable. At one restaurant, as soon as the waiter set the water on the table, I chugged the glass immediately and instructed him to keep them coming, that I was extra thirsty. My husband looked at me with concern and kept the gummies coming, which were still keeping the nausea at a manageable level. My additional stomach ailments continued, but I pushed through them and tried to make the best of it, still under the spell of a heavy brain fog.

After another night of vomiting and immediately popping gummies as soon as I woke up, my husband and I put our heads together. We ran through the list of symptoms I had been experiencing, coming up clueless. Next, we thought back on anything that had changed recently. Aha! Indeed, my psychiatrist had increased my lithium right before we left for vacation.

Only knowing that connection, we began to research my symptoms plus the keyword ‘lithium’. Immediately, tons of links popped up about lithium toxicity, something neither one of us knew anything about. It seemed serious, but some of the stories I read seemed a lot graver than mine, so I figured I wasn’t in need of emergency care. I simply discontinued the lithium, and we went home the next day. Not getting back until later in the evening, it was the following day before I could go in for an emergency blood draw to check my lithium levels, something that had been done frequently throughout my nearly 25-year history of being on the medication.

I had been put on lithium for my early bipolar (then later schizoaffective) diagnosis when I was 18 years old, after spending the previous year psychiatrically hospitalized seven times for depression, anxiety, psychosis and unstable mood. I was promised mood stability and less suicidal ideation. It was supposedly the leading option, my best line of defense. That is what I was told for the next 25 years, but I was never told about lithium toxicity.

From the start, the side effects were horrible. So much GI distress and unquenchable thirst, which I know now was my kidneys urgently trying to rid my body of the essential poison of the drug. I learned to deal with it. Every now and then, during times of stability, my doctor would agree to let me discontinue it, but it never lasted more than six months. I had spent over half my life on lithium.

I knew from past experience that my lithium level usually landed around .7, a fine, therapeutic level. Once lithium is stopped, the levels decrease pretty quickly. So, after missing two days of medication, I was very surprised when my bloodwork came back with a level of 1.4. This meant it had to have been even higher in the preceding days. I did indeed have lithium toxicity. Being off the medication, I was already feeling better, so I really felt like if there had been an emergency, it had passed. And thankfully I happened to have an appointment with my psychiatrist that week.

I told her what happened and she was concerned, to say the least, left wondering why it happened. The increased thirst, I learned, was my body’s way of trying to flush the drug out of my kidneys. Since the emergency had passed, my psychiatrist had me do another blood draw, this time the levels amounting to .5, and decided it would be okay to restart the lithium at a reduced dose. Nothing else bad happened for several years.

Many say that lithium is a vile drug to the body. Others say that it is an excellent drug for the mentally ill mind. I would agree with both. It caused a terrible tremor that embarrassed me most of the time. It left me having to run to the bathroom within 10-15 minutes of eating, for years. I would have to plan ahead with Imodium for road trips, airplane rides, and even some social events. For a long time, I was drinking four 40-oz bottles of water a day, which of course left me always having to pee. However, it did seem to work for my mental health. I found it to be a good medication for suicidal ideation, something I deeply struggled with, as well as a stabilizer for my sometimes unmanageable mood swings. For these reasons, despite the physical aggravation, I stayed on the medication.

Fast forward three years later: one evening, about an hour after taking my nightly meds, I once again got very sick. I ran to the bathroom three or four times, purging a total of 20 times that night. My shaking was more pronounced than usual, and something just didn’t feel right. I hadn’t been this wrathfully sick since I had lithium toxicity three years prior. But there had been no increase in dosage, this time. Maybe this was just food poisoning? But deep down, I knew it felt different. I skipped my morning dose of lithium and went to the doctor that afternoon for another emergency blood draw.

My levels were fine at .6. I remained unconvinced, so I did not take my lithium for the next several days, during which I felt fine. I started thinking that maybe it had just been food poisoning after all, and that it was safe to restart the lithium since my levels did not point toward toxicity. I woke up and took my morning dose. Within the next few hours, my nausea began to grow more intense, which continued throughout the day, along with relentless diarrhea. After taking my nightly dose, I had to take a Zofran and crawl into the bed early.

The next day, I bravely took my lithium again first thing upon waking up, with my handful of other meds, and waited. The nausea began and I knew something wasn’t right. Shortly after, I threw up, but since I had not eaten, it was not as severe as the times before. It’s just not agreeing with me anymore, I thought, and made the decision to discontinue until I saw my psychiatrist two weeks later.

During the following two weeks, I experienced some emotional turmoil, but my body had never felt better. My bathroom habits resembled those of a normal person, my shaking had decreased some, I wasn’t guzzling as much water throughout the day, and I felt more clearheaded. As I finally sat down with my psychiatrist, I became very emotional about the whole ordeal. Historically, I felt that lithium had helped me more than hurt me, and with a tearful expression and cracking voice I said, “My body just doesn’t seem to be tolerating it anymore,” as I weepily described the events that had transpired in the previous weeks. Compassionately, she told me we could stay off the lithium for now. I was so relieved.

I have come to learn that in some cases, after long-term use of lithium, the kidneys’ ability to clear the drug changes, so the dose the body had handled for decades can become something it can no longer process the way it did before. I don’t know if I’ll ever be able to get back on lithium, but my mental state is stable and I am on another mood stabilizer, so I can’t complain. It was just a trip to have my body make a decision without me to cease a relationship I’d had with something for so long.

Mad in America hosts blogs by a diverse group of writers. These posts are designed to serve as a public forum for a discussion—broadly speaking—of psychiatry and its treatments. The opinions expressed are the writers’ own.

author: CNT Aranjuez
title: AlTajo 88 Noviembre 2026
content:
AlTajo88Nov2026

Descarga




Buenas compas!




Como cada mes, os hacemos llegar la revista ALTAJO, órgano de expresión de la CNT de Aranjuez. En vuestra bandeja de entrada o en la web de CNT Aranjuez os encontraréis los anteriores 87 números de esta revista, ya que hoy, presentamos el número 88 del mes de noviembre de 2026.




Un mes en el que hay convocada una huelga general el miércoles 11, además de haber varias huelgas sectoriales activas, de las cuales resaltamos aquellas en las que participamos desde CNT Aranjuez, ya sea apoyando, como es el caso de la huelga de Educación Infantil en la Comunidad de Madrid (7 meses de huelga), y convocando, como es el caso de la huelga docente de Educación Pública de la Comunidad de Madrid (un mes de huelga en todas las etapas). En nuestra sección SINDICALISMO, como no podía ser de otra manera, encontraréis artículos sobre las dos huelgas docentes.




Abriendo nuestra revista este mes, en la sección A VOCES, recogemos el Manifiesto Confederal para el 11N, también una reflexión y alegato a la huelga, de Yanis Merinkis, y cierra esta sección Azucena Arráns denunciando las restricciones en la frontera de Kerem Abu Salem que amenaza con la hambruna nuevamente al pueblo gazatí.




En la sección CULTURA LIBRE, dos colaboraciones de la Asociación Cultural La Casa Negra para hablarnos de Memoria histórica y de historias ocurridas en Aranjuez «el verano que acabó con la primavera». Los Archiveros del Real Sitio de Lizania continúan su estudio de la obra del gran poeta anarquista y nos presentan su artículo «Lorca en Lizano». Cerrando la sección, Fernando Barbero aporta luz sobre la figura de Teresa Claramunt Creus en una nueva entrega de «Mujeres anarquistas abriendo huella.»




Nuestra sección PIENSO LUEGO EXISTO recoge una nueva reflexión y denuncia de Yanis Merinakis sobre las actitudes autoritarias dentro de organizaciones libertarias. Hablamos también de nuestro BiciTaller Colaborativo que sigue cada mes funcionando (y podéis sumaros si aún no tuvisteis oportunidad). También en esta sección encontramos un nuevo relato de Sotiris Dimitriu traducido por Yanis Merinakis. Domingo Martínez nos aporta dos nuevas reseñas de libros, ambas editadas por la Fundación Anselmo Lorenzo (FAL). Recogemos el catálogo de ediciones de FAL Aranjuez y por último las próximas convocatorias a la que esperamos podáis asistir.




Deseamos que os resulte enriquecedor y estimulante este nuevo número 88 de la revista ALTAJO y os animamos a participar en este proyecto colectivo.

Salud y acierto!




La entrada 

AlTajo 88 Noviembre 2026

 se publicó primero en 

Confederación Nacional del Trabajo

.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: "They Have Eyes": How Trump's Corruption Became a Top Concern for Midterm Voters
content:
Democrats regained control of both the House and the Senate in Tuesday’s historic midterm elections, a comeback fueled largely by voter anger over high prices and the war on Iran. But surveys also found that corruption was a major concern, with 76% of voters telling a Harris poll that elected officials care more about enriching themselves than improving the economy for ordinary people. A separate Reuters/Ipsos poll found that 63% of Americans considered it inappropriate for Trump and his family to profit from cryptocurrency, while 69% said his private business interests influence his decisions as president.




“If this election was about corruption and cost, then this next Congress needs to be focused on accountability and affordability,” says Donald Sherman, the president and 

CEO

 of Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington, or 

CREW

.




“Congress needs to do oversight not just on the administration’s corruption, not just on the president’s profiteering, but also on corporate America, what they have gotten out of engaging in the president’s pay-to-play environment, how corporate America and the outside influence of money in our political system has undermined the public voice in our policy discussions.”

title: Assemblea di Ateneo a Pisa il 9/11 ore 11:30
content:
I costi della vita aumentano, la benzina e i trasporti anche. Intanto, il governo pensa solo ad aumentare la spesa militare, peggiorando la situazione in cui ci troviamo. E così vengono sacrificati i servizi pubblici e tagliati i fondi all’istruzione e all’università.




Il 9 novembre ci troviamo in assemblea d’ateneo: adesso decidiamo noi!




L’assemblea d’ateneo è un’occasione rarissima in università, perché a noi studenti non vengono mai concessi gli spazi per discutere e decidere insieme. Con le mobilitazioni di queste settimane e l’occupazione di Palazzo della Sapienza, abbiamo ottenuto una prima vittoria: quattro ore di sospensione didattica per tutti, per poter partecipare liberamente. Quest’assemblea sarà un primo momento per incontrarci tutt insieme e organizzarci sulla nostra vita. Se l’Università, il DSU e le altre istituzioni non si prendono le proprie responsabilità, dobbiamo essere noi a pretenderlo. Ci servono più appelli, l’estensione del contributo affitto, l’abbassamento dei prezzi della mensa, non stiamo mica chiedendo la luna! Come ci organizziamo per ottenerlo?




Le nostre richieste sono chiare ed è possibile agire da subito!




Su questo e tanti altri problemi abbiamo cominciato a confrontarci e attivarci, stilando una lista di richieste. Le puoi leggere nel comunicato di occupazione della Sapienza al QR code nel post. Leggiamole, aggiungiamone altre, discutiamone insieme all’assemblea d’ateneo! Da lì vogliamo partire per organizzarci praticamente in ogni polo, in ogni residenza, in ogni mensa, in ogni corso di studi.




Ci vediamo lunedì 9 novembre alle 11.30 nell’Aula Magna del Polo Carmignani, pranziamo insieme!







Qui di seguito il 

comunicato

 dell’occupazione

 




Ieri 30 ottobre 2026 siamo scese in piazza per lo sciopero generale chiamato da USB e molti sindacati di base, uno sciopero internazionale contro il carovita e la guerra: più di 100 porti sono stati bloccati per interrompere i flussi della guerra e la sua logistica. Le piazze gremite in tutta Italia hanno detto una cosa molto chiara: noi la guerra non la paghiamo.




Investire sulla guerra è una scelta politica, non solo di questo governo ma di tutta l’oligarchia globale. La guerra non è solo un’ipotesi futura, la guerra occupa già il nostro presente: la paghiamo con il rincaro dei prezzi al supermercato, sui trasporti, sul carburante, sulle bollette. La paghiamo quando il nostro diritto allo studio viene eroso di giorno in giorno, e quando le nostre università, spolpate di fondi e definanziate, devono convertire la propria ricerca agli interessi delle aziende e dell’industria bellica.




Le tante voci alzatesi in corteo oggi nella nostra città si sono unite nella decisione di occupare il palazzo della Sapienza, sede storica dell’università di Pisa, sempre meno a disposizione dellə studentə e sempre più rifunzionalizzata per essere vetrina dell’istituzione. La Sapienza, però, è anche il luogo dove si sono prodotte nel 1967 le 

Tesi

, documento programmatico del movimento studentesco che avrebbe trasformato l’università negli anni successivi. Nelle 

Tesi

della

Sapienza

dellə studentə in lotta di sessant’anni fa si legge che “l’università appartiene alla base universitaria”. Siamo qui oggi per gridarlo di nuovo a gran voce.




L’università è di chi ci studia e di chi ci lavora. Chiediamo condizioni dignitose per chi le nostre università le tiene aperte, le pulisce e le vive. Vogliamo ribellarci al futuro che ci viene prospettato fatto di precarietà e di saperi svenduti alla guerra e alla devastazione del territorio. Università e conoscenza sono beni pubblici, di cui dobbiamo prenderci cura. L’università deve essere un luogo accessibile a tuttə, che rispetti il nostro tempo e i nostri bisogni, in cui crescere insieme, costruire un futuro collettivo, dove custodire i saperi e metterli a disposizione di un territorio da tutelare.




Immaginiamo un’università che non sia un’autostrada da percorrere per la propria carriera, ma una piazza dove condividere il nostro desiderio di conoscenza e di trasformazione. In tutto il mondo le persone riempiono le strade e dalle università ai porti tutto si può bloccare: l’occupazione della Sapienza è solo una prima pietra lanciata nella nostra città nella nuova ondata di rabbia e desiderio di riscatto che sta animando tutto il Mediterraneo.




Con questa occupazione vogliamo avanzare pretese rivolte al Governo, al Ministero dell’Università e della Ricerca, all’Università di Pisa e all’Azienda Regionale per il Diritto allo Studio (DSU Toscana).




Al

governo

–

contro

la

finanziaria

di

guerra,

contro

il

carovita




Chiediamo:







Il reinvestimento in istruzione, ricerca e sanità di tutti i fondi aggiuntivi previsti per la difesa nella nuova legge di bilancio del 2027.




Il ripristino del taglio delle accise sui carburanti di 24,4 centesimi complessivi.




La modifica del Codice degli appalti, affinché ci sia una progressiva internalizzazione dellə lavoratorə, a partire dalle università.




Un aumento di 5 miliardi di euro del Fondo di Finanziamento Universitario.







Al

Ministero

–

contro

la

privatizzazione

degli

studentati,

contro

l’università

trattata

come

fosse

 

un’azienda







Che il 96% dei 33mila posti letto negli studentati costruiti coi fondi PNRR, attualmente in mano ai privati, vengano posti sotto l’ente pubblico, uscendo dal circuito del mercato







immobiliare. Chiediamo inoltre che vengano resi disponibili gli altri 27 mila posti letto promessi dal PNRR e non ancora realizzati.







La modifica dei criteri di premialità nella distribuzione dei finanziamenti all’Università.







All’Università

di

Pisa

–

per

un’università

che

risponda

ai

bisogni

dellə

studenti







Indennità e rimborso spese per i tirocini curriculari. I tirocini non sono lavoro gratuito e le spese per sostenerli non possono gravare sullə singolə.




Flessibilità e tutela del percorso di studi: ampliamento degli appelli ed estensione delle sessioni straordinarie per borsistə. La nostra vita universitaria deve seguire il ritmo dei nostri bisogni, senza ricatti.




Accesso aperto alla conoscenza e agli strumenti di studio. Chiediamo il ripristino e il potenziamento di tutti gli abbonamenti universitari alle risorse bibliografiche, banche dati e riviste digitali, unitamente alla fornitura di licenze software gratuite per tutti i programmi informatici specialistici richiesti dai vari corsi di laurea.




Spazi universitari accessibili e vivibili. I poli didattici e le biblioteche devono estendere i propri orari di apertura, garantendo l’accesso continuo anche nelle fasce serali, nei fine settimana, rendendo la città universitaria in un luogo diffuso di studio, confronto e socialità.




Diritto alla mobilità e sostenibilità. Chiediamo uno stanziamento economico dedicato al trasporto pubblico su gomma e su ferro per garantire la gratuità o comunque una forte agevolazione dei titoli di viaggio per la popolazione studentesca pendolare. Chiediamo di concordare con le aziende di trasporto il potenziamento delle corse di autobus e treni regionali nelle fasce orarie di maggiore affluenza.




Rigenerazione urbana e sostenibilità edilizia. L’Ateneo deve dare assoluta priorità alla ristrutturazione, manutenzione e rifunzionalizzazione degli edifici già presenti nel centro storico di Pisa. Chiediamo l’interruzione delle politiche di cementificazione e della creazione di nuovi poli periferici isolati dal tessuto sociale cittadino, privi di servizi adeguati e difficilmente raggiungibili.




Difesa del patrimonio pubblico universitario. Chiediamo che l’Università si impegni attivamente a tutelare la funzione sociale e studentesca dei propri immobili. Di fronte alle previsioni del Piano Operativo Comunale, che prospetta la conversione in parcheggi di presidi fondamentali come la mensa Martiri e l’aula studio Pacinotti, l’Ateneo deve prendere una posizione netta a garanzia della continuità d’uso di tali spazi per la comunità universitaria.




Disarmo accademico e responsabilità etica della ricerca. Chiediamo l’interruzione di ogni accordo, convenzione e collaborazione di ricerca con le aziende della filiera bellica e con realtà coinvolte in contesti di occupazione e violazione dei diritti, inclusa la revisione della partecipazione dell’Ateneo a progetti di ricerca europei come il programma Horizon con fini o risvolti militari.







Al

DSU

–

Diritti

in

accessibili:

le

condizioni

del

diritto

allo

studio

universitario

della

Toscana




È una tendenza ormai conclamata il progressivo smantellamento dei servizi dell’azienda regionale del diritto allo studio (ARDSU), tramite privatizzazione o riduzione dei benefici erogati. Questo succede tramite diverse strategie, tra i quali l’innalzamento spropositato dei costi della mensa o l’esternalizzazione dei servizi, e quindi dellə lavoratorə. Noi non staremo a guardare mentre ci levano il terreno sotto i piedi. Per questo chiediamo:







Che tuttə lə idoneə siano beneficiariə, e che le graduatorie definitive vadano in base all’ISEE, e non al numero dei CFU conseguiti. Al momento, infatti, nelle graduatorie l’ISEE conta al







20%, mentre il numero di CFU- quindi la quantità di esami che sei riuscite a dare – conta per il restante 80%.







Che lə studentə beneficiariə del posto alloggio ricevano subito una soluzione abitativa. Basta attese di mesi per avere il diritto che ci spetta.




Di ridefinire il tempo massimo del conseguimento dei CFU necessari al mantenimento della borsa di studio, considerando anche l’appello di settembre come sessione utile per questo fine. Di conseguenza, dilatare i tempi per la richiesta di borsa.




Che il contributo affitto sia una possibilità realmente percorribile per tuttə: la possibilità di richiesta deve essere aperta tutto l’anno e deve essere garantito a tuttə lə studentə beneficiariə di posto alloggio che non hanno ottenuto il posto in residenza.




Che la mensa ritorni ad avere prezzi calmierati e accessibili per tuttə, non soltanto per le fasce di reddito più basso.




Che le strutture delle residenze siano realmente adeguate per lə studentə che le abitano. Vogliamo: manutenzioni e interventi strutturali immediati dove servono, wi-fi e lavatrici gratuite in tutte le residenze, cucine funzionanti.




Che vengano aumentate le linee di trasporto pubblico nei pressi dei complessi universitari, fuori e dentro il centro storico della città. Che ci siano agevolazioni concrete anche per i treni e le linee extraurbane usate dallə studentə pendolari.

title: First Gen Z Congresswoman: DSA's Melat Kiros on Corruption, Medicare for All & Israel
content:
The Democratic Socialists of America made major gains in this year’s U.S. midterms, electing not just the largest-ever socialist bloc to Congress, but also winning dozens of races at the state, county and municipal levels. 

Democracy Now!

 spoke with Congressmember-elect Melat Kiros on election night following her victory in Denver, Colorado. She identified Medicare for All as her top priority and said progressives must lay the groundwork “so that in ’29, when we have the House, the Senate and the White House, we can sign it into law on day one.”




Kiros is a 29-year-old Ethiopian immigrant and lawyer. In 2023, Kiros wrote an open letter about the danger of conflating antisemitism and criticism of Israel, for which she was fired by her law firm. She won a major upset in the Democratic primary earlier this year against longtime incumbent Congressmember Diana DeGette.

title: Vademecum di resistenza legale. Sanzioni amministrative pecuniarie e iter giudiziario
content:
Le sanzioni amministrative sono uno strumento per colpire il dissenso. I decreti sicurezza del governo Meloni hanno rafforzato un impianto normativo che corrode i diritti d’espressione e a manifestare, sanciti dall’artt.17 e 21 della Costituzione. 




Riprendiamo da Torino per Gaza




Manifestare diventa sempre più una “concessione” o un “permesso” delle Autorità, spesso limitato da prescrizioni. Sottoponendo chi manifesta a un rischio economico permanente, mentre economia di guerra e carovita, intrecciate alla situazione geopolitica e alla crisi ecoclimatica ci asfissiano, si produce un effetto intimidatorio aggravando la minaccia della repressione economica.

In questo quadro, il D.L. 23/2026, convertito dalla L. 54/2026 ha modificato l’art.18 del TULPS (prevede che le manifestazioni in luogo pubblico siano preventivamente – almeno tre giorni prima – comunicate alla Questura), intervenendo in modo significativo sul sistema sanzionatorio delle manifestazioni pubbliche. La violazione dell’obbligo di preavviso è stata depenalizzata, cioè trasformata da reato in illecito amministrativo, punito con una sanzione pecuniaria. Lo stesso è avvenuto per la violazione dei divieti e delle prescrizioni del Questore, e sono state introdotte nuove sanzioni anche per altre condotte tenute durante le manifestazioni. Le sanzioni arrivano fino a 12.000 euro, senza possibilità di pagamento in misura ridotta, e aumentano per chi accumula più violazioni.

Quest’evoluzione è parte della rappresaglia governativa per il “Blocchiamo tutto”, le proteste sindacali e degli attivisti per la giustizia climatica. La mobilitazione dal basso ha dimostrato i limiti di questi tentativi di imbrigliare e criminalizzare la legittima resistenza popolare. La stessa repressione con cui il governo risponde altro non è che il risultato dell’efficacia di quelle mobilitazioni e pratiche.




La difesa legale e l’iniziativa politica possono procedere insieme e rafforzarsi a vicenda. Questo è il modo concreto per ostacolare l’applicazione dei decreti sicurezza e organizzarsi collettivamente per non pagare alcuna sanzione e spuntare una delle principali armi della repressione.

Dobbiamo organizzarci per resistere agli attacchi, trasformando ogni tentativo di colpirci in un’occasione di solidarietà e di rilancio della mobilitazione. Dove ci vogliono isolati e soli noi reagiamo collettivamente.

Bando all’improvvisazione: dobbiamo dotarci di strumenti per affrontare ogni singolo attacco e trasformarlo in un terreno di crescita e avanzamento delle nostre lotte. Pertanto, abbiamo predisposto un Vademecum su come affrontare queste sanzioni.







Il Vademecum è stato redatto assieme a legali che in Italia si stanno organizzando per affrontare la difesa delle persone e dei movimenti colpiti.




Oltre al mancato preavviso, sono sanzionate anche la violazione dei divieti e delle prescrizioni del Questore, la presa di parola nelle riunioni non preavvisate, il mancato rispetto del percorso, la turbativa e la promozione della riunione online o in gruppi chiusi. Per chi accumula più violazioni le sanzioni aumentano da un terzo alla metà.

Se ricevi una sanzione amministrativa per art.18 TULPS come modificato dall’art. 9 del D.L. 23/2026, convertito dalla L. 54/2026, ti consigliamo di NON PAGARE ALCUNA SANZIONE nell’immediato, di rivolgerti alle reti solidali e a un legale di tua fiducia per predisporre il ricorso. Ecco in breve come si procede




⇩

VERBALE DI ACCERTAMENTO E CONTESTAZIONE

Redatto dall’organo accertatore (Questura/DIGOS, Carabinieri…), descrive il fatto imputato e le violazioni contestate e avvisa che la sanzione (da 1.000 a 10.000 €, che passano da 1.000 a 12.000 € per la violazione di divieti e prescrizioni – Sul verbale la multa è indicata come minimi e massimi ma non è quantificata) verrà successivamente quantificata dal Prefetto con un’ordinanza-ingiunzione.




Tale verbale deve arrivare entro 90 giorni dall’accertamento, indicando in 30 giorni la possibilità di effettuare scritti difensivi presso il Prefetto. È possibile, secondo valutazioni proprie e confrontandosi con i propri legali, presentare scritti difensivi in questa fase e chiedere di essere ascoltati personalmente dal Prefetto (il verbale non si impugna davanti al giudice!).

Se invece il verbale arriva oltre il termine, la sanzione si estingue (conserva la busta e la data di notifica!).




⇩

ORDINANZA – INGIUNZIONE PREFETTIZIA

L’ordinanza-ingiunzione, emessa dal Prefetto a sua discrezione, definisce la somma sanzionata. Le ingiunzioni hanno tempo 5 anni per essere erogate. Queste, possono arrivare anche molto tempo dopo il verbale. Il limite è la prescrizione: 5 anni dalla violazione. Ogni atto notificato (il verbale, l’ordinanza, una cartella) fa ripartire il conteggio da capo. Conserva sempre tutte le buste con le date di notifica: servono all’avvocato per verificare se la sanzione è prescritta. Attenzione: può essere recapitata anche tramite l’app “IO” dove i termini possono decorrere anche se non apri il messaggio!

A questo punto scattano 30 giorni dalla notifica per fare ricorso al Giudice di Pace del luogo dei fatti (in alcuni casi la competenza potrebbe essere del Tribunale).

Chi ha un reddito basso (fino a (13.659,64 euro) può chiedere il patrocinio a spese dello Stato.




SE NON CONCOSCI UN AVVOCATO, CHIEDI IL RIFERIMENTO ALL’ASSEMBLEA!




⇩

RICORSO

Il ricorso richiede un costo di contributo unificato.

Il Giudice di Pace fissa un’udienza che può essere con sospensiva del pagamento.

Nel ricorso, oltre ai motivi relativi al singolo caso, si può eccepire l’illegittimità costituzionale della norma. In udienza l’avvocat* potrà chiedere al giudice di rimettere la questione alla Corte costituzionale. Se il giudice la ritiene rilevante e non manifestamente infondata, sospende il giudizio in attesa della decisione della Corte.




Obiettivo politico della resistenza legale e collettiva è arrivare alla dichiarazione di incostituzionalità.

Se invece il Giudice non accoglie il rinvio alla Corte Costituzionale, potrà confermare la sanzione, rideterminarla o annullarla. Si potrà eventualmente procedere in Appello e in Cassazione.




⇩

LA CASSA DI RESISTENZA

Per tradurre la risposta collettiva, disinnescare il ricatto della repressione economica a livello individuale e fare fronte alle spese legali, viene messa a disposizione la Cassa di resistenza legale promossa da Torino per Gaza.




Se hai bisogno, chiedi sostengo. Se sei un solidale o un’organizzazione, contribuisci alla Cassa promuovendo raccolte fondi!

Puoi contribuire attraverso il crowdfunding:

https://www.produzionidalbasso.com/project/cassa-di-resistenza-blocchiamo-tutto-torino-2/







Se hai preso una multa, scrivici e organizziamoci insieme:

NESSUNA RESTA DA SOLA, NESSUNO RESTA DA SOLO!

Daniel Nichanianeditor-in-chief of Bolts, a publication that covers local politics and policy with a focus on voting rights and criminal justice.

We examine the results of Tuesday’s historic U.S. midterm elections with Daniel Nichanian, editor-in-chief of Bolts. In addition to taking back the House and Senate, Democrats also made major gains at the state level and will control a majority of governorships for the first time in 16 years. Democrats also flipped 12 state legislative chambers.

“The size of the wins for Democrats in statewide races was wild,” says Nichanian. He identifies protecting abortion access, bolstering unions and ending police cooperation with ICE as some of the priorities Democrats are likely to pursue.

Daniel Nichanianeditor-in-chief of Bolts, a publication that covers local politics and policy with a focus on voting rights and criminal justice.

NERMEEN SHAIKH: We begin today’s show continuing our look at Tuesday’s historic election. On the national level, Democrats took control of the House and Senate in a stunning rebuke of President Trump. Meanwhile, Democrats have flipped 12 state legislative chambers. In Arizona, Democrats are set to control the state Legislature for the first time in 60 years. In Pennsylvania, Democrats flipped the state Senate for the first time since 1994. And for the first time in 16 years, Democrats will hold a majority of governorships, including in Texas, where Gina Hinojosa is the first Democrat elected governor since Ann Richards in 1990.

Florida’s outgoing Republican Governor Ron DeSantis spoke Wednesday about Republican losses across the country.

GOV. RON DESANTIS: This is close to an extinction-level event for Republicans in many parts of the country as we have seen probably in the last hundred years. In January, when everyone in office leaves who are either term-limited or got voted out, of the 10 largest states in this union, only one state will have Republican control of their state: the state of Florida.

If you look at our chief rival, in a healthy sense, the state of Texas, and I would say over the last — over my lifetime, Texas has been the crown jewel of Republican politics. I think we’ve been the leader for Republicans and conservatives since I’ve been governor, but if you go over the whole generation, no one holds a candle on the Republican side to the Lone Star State. And yet, not only did they lose a very highly publicized U.S. Senate race, they lost everything — the governor, attorney general, all the other statewide. They lost four Republican Supreme Court justices on the Texas Supreme Court. They may even lose the Texas Legislature, or one house or even both. Let’s just be clear that that is going to hurt not just for the next two years. That’s something that can reverberate for the next decade or more. And if the Republican Party doesn’t have Texas as an anchor, then we are not going to be viable nationally going forward.

AMY GOODMAN: That was Florida’s Republican Governor Ron DeSantis.

Many political commentators have credited New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani with helping make affordability a central issue for Democrats. On Wednesday, Mayor Mamdani posted a video reacting to the midterm results.

MAYOR ZOHRAN MAMDANI: Last night’s election proved working people expect more from their government, and they’re tired of waiting. JD Vance asked for a couple more years to finally fulfill the promises he’d made to our country. Working people can’t afford another two years to make rent that’s due this month, childcare for their kids or groceries for their family. People are tired of being told that there isn’t enough to go around, while Elon Musk becomes the world’s first trillionaire. They are tired of being told to sacrifice their land and water for data centers. They’re tired of being told their needs are unrealistic by politicians who have been bought by the wealthiest people on the planet. They’re tired of being told to ask for a little and expect even less.

And last night, the people stood up. They stood up to politicians that spend their taxpayer dollars on war crimes and genocide instead of on building schools and paving roads. They spoke louder than the hundreds of millions of dollars that tried and failed to buy this election. They demanded an end to the affordability crisis that has become one of the few things that unites us all. It is not enough to simply win power; we must use it. And the American people will know the difference between hollow words and hard work. For years we’ve had the debate. Now it’s time for us in the Democratic Party to deliver. My friends, it’s morning again in America.

AMY GOODMAN: Our first guest today has been closely looking at results in state races across the United States. Daniel Nichanian is editor-in-chief of Bolts, a publication that covers local politics and policy with a focus on voting rights and criminal justice, joining us now from Washington, D.C.

Daniel, thanks so much for being with us. I mean, you take a state like Texas, and Governor DeSantis focused on this when he talks about this election was a extinction-level event for Republicans. Now the leadership of Texas, both the governorship as well as the Senate, these two races, are Democrat. And this hasn’t happened in decades. You’ve looked at something that is less well known at this point after the election, which is what’s happening at the state levels in the state legislatures, and what all of this can mean. Lay out what your observations are after this historic election.

DANIEL NICHANIAN: So, I think the thing that we all know is that Republicans suffered very heavy losses for Congress. You were just talking about the big gains for Democrats in the Senate, where they could get up to 56 seats, and in the House. What is still coming into view at this moment is the sheer extent to which Republicans suffered similar losses — to be honest, even greater losses, unthinkable losses even — in state governments and local governments.

So, let’s take the state of Texas, which is really the story of the night and the symbol of the night that you were just discussing. Democrats, of course, flipped the Senate seat and the governor’s mansion, but that just hides so much that’s going on beyond the surface. They may have flipped the state Board of Education, which has drawn so many headlines over many years for injecting Christianity into schools. They flipped four seats on the state’s highest court, the Supreme Court, including electing a woman who will be the first LGBTQ statewide official in Texas. They flipped the state House. They flipped attorney general, railroad commissioner, land commissioner and so on.

And then, if you look down-ballot further down, the situation remains as dire for the GOP. So, in one of the biggest counties in the nation, home to Fort Worth, Democrats flipped the DA’s office. They flipped the county executive’s office. They flipped the county board. These are all important offices. This county drew a lot of headlines over the last few weeks for closing polling stations. They have lots of impacts on people’s lives. There was really nowhere that Republicans could hide on Tuesday to escape the wrath of voters, and this showed in state after state after state.

NERMEEN SHAIKH: So, hi, Daniel, so good to see you. So, what is your sense at the state and local level? What were voters most interested in? What made them vote Democrat this time?

DANIEL NICHANIAN: Well, it’s, you know, the similar reasons as we saw at the federal level: the cost of living. Democrats in Texas and Ohio and many states were really emphasizing the issue of data centers, immigration enforcement. And those are all issues where we are going to see now that Democrats took more power in state governments. We’re going to see actual potential changes being done at a level of government where that has a lot of effects on these — on these issues.

So, for instance, the Democrats took control of six state governments on Tuesday, perhaps seven if Alaska flips. We are still waiting for results there in the governor’s race. So, we’re talking about Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Arizona, Michigan, Minnesota and Nevada. Those all are states that became Democratic now. And some of these states, the Democrats haven’t governed for a very long time, and they’ve signaled the kind of agenda they want to bring. So, for instance, in Pennsylvania, which Democrats haven’t governed since the '90s, they've signaled they want to codify abortion rights into the state Constitution. In Wisconsin, where Democrats haven’t governed since 2010, they have signaled they want to repeal, abolish the anti-union law that Scott Walker very famously — it drew a lot of protests nationwide and in Wisconsin — passed in 2011. So, in a way, there’s a lot of issues that have built up, up until Tuesday.

NERMEEN SHAIKH: And, Daniel, you’ve also said — I mean, let’s talk about the places where the Democrats didn’t prevail, or at least don’t have, won’t have full control. Georgia, North Carolina, you say, is also because of gerrymandering, Republican gerrymandering. If you could explain?

DANIEL NICHANIAN: Right. I mean, you know, the story you may have heard out there over the past few days is that gerrymandering failed for Republicans in the U.S. House. They were trying to gerrymander their way into a majority. That didn’t succeed.

The situation is more nuanced if you look at the state level. Georgia and North Carolina are two states that saw huge tsunamis on Tuesday. The statewide offices flipped. The size of the wins for Democrats in statewide races was wild, I mean, unthinkable even. And yet, and yet, Democrats didn’t manage to win control of the state government. Why? Because the state Senate in both states is so aggressively gerrymandered that Democrats just couldn’t get over the hurdle.

In North Carolina, for instance, Democrats are one seat short of getting full control of the state government, despite the gerrymander. They won every seat that Trump won by up to 10 points. Any seat that Trump won by less than 10 flipped Democrat. And that wasn’t enough, because the median seat in North Carolina has been so gerrymandered, is so Republican, so that allowed Republicans to keep a foothold of power in states where, by all accounts, they really should have lost everything on Tuesday.

AMY GOODMAN: So, Daniel Nichanian, let’s talk about what states can do all over the country, the significance of states having power. I mean, you have the irony that with President Trump and with the Republicans, they’re often talking about states’ rights, but then they try to federalize everything from the election to law enforcement. So, if you can talk about, oh, states passing laws that ban local police and local sheriffs from collaborating with ICE, for example? Where can states assert themselves?

DANIEL NICHANIAN: I mean, that’s really important. It’s going to be a major storyline, looking ahead to 2027. On many of the issues that people look toward D.C., you know, states have a lot of power. That’s a great example, the issue of immigration, which was a driving factor for many voters, the opposition to Trump’s immigration policies and ICE over the last year and a half.

What we have seen, actually, since Trump came into power in 2025, came back into power, is a wave of states, of blue states, of Democratic-governed states, that have passed laws that have banned local police and local sheriffs from entering contracts with ICE. Now, that actually does — is very important, because ICE really relies on the collaboration of local sheriff agencies and police to expand its reach. For instance — for instance, sheriffs can rent space in their jails to ICE to hold immigrants. ICE can bring immigrants there, pay money to the sheriff’s department — by the way, it also puts more money into local law enforcement through that route — and that helps ICE do its operations. And so, nine states, nine Democratic-run states, since the beginning of 2025, have banned these sort of contracts. States like Virginia, New Mexico, Maryland have passed laws like that.

Now, the obvious question — I was listing earlier the list of states that Democrats have flipped. Are we going to see similar laws in Pennsylvania, in Wisconsin, in Arizona? These are all states where local sheriffs — there are some very far-right sheriffs in those states that have contracts with ICE. Are Democrats at the state level going to do something about it? So, that’s just an example of the kind of questions that this really opens up. And you could do that on issue after issue. What are Democrats going to do with the new authority they’re going to have in these states?

NERMEEN SHAIKH: And if you could speak, Daniel, specifically about unions, the states that have had extremely restrictive laws on unions? If you could just talk, for example, about Wisconsin or Nevada?

DANIEL NICHANIAN: Right. I mean, another issue where Democrats have not as systematically done recently, the politics around unions having shifted a bit. But Nevada, Wisconsin are — and others are states that have either passed a right-to-work law or — in Wisconsin, as I was saying earlier, it was really the — it was really one of the main issues when Republicans took power after the 2010 midterms. They went after unions in Wisconsin and other states. And Democrats, Democrats want to roll that back. And we’ll see. Also, there was an important referendum in Vermont on Tuesday that enshrined the right to join a union into the Constitution of the state of Vermont, and that also passed on Tuesday, so another important result.

AMY GOODMAN: We want to thank you, Daniel Nichanian, editor-in-chief of Bolts, a publication that covers local politics and policy with a focus on voting rights and criminal justice.

Coming up, we speak to Congressmember-elect Melat Kiros, the 29-year-old attorney, Ethiopian immigrant, member of the Democratic Socialists of America, who beat in the Democratic primary Congressmember DeGette, who was in office for almost 30 years. She will now represent Denver, Colorado, in the next Congress. Stay with us.

title: Cremona: sabato 7 novembre manifestazione “Adèss Baasta” contro carovita e riarmo
content:
Studenti e lavoratori pronti a scendere in piazza a Cremona contro il carovita e il riarmo: sabato 7 novembre si terrà infatti una manifestazione con lo slogan Adèss Baasta, che mira a riunire studenti, lavoratori, giovani e associazioni. Il ritrovo è fissato alle 14 nel parcheggio dell’ex Foro Boario, in via Mantova. La partenza del corteo è prevista per le 15.




Da Radio Onda d’Urto




Al centro della mobilitazione ci sono soprattutto il rincaro dei carburanti, l’aumento dei prezzi dei beni di consumo e il peso delle bollette. Nel testo che accompagna la locandina, gli organizzatori scrivono: “Il diesel ha superato i 2 euro al litro, la spesa costa di più ogni giorno, gli stipendi non bastano e l’inverno ci aspetta con bollette salatissime”. La protesta si rivolge anche alle scelte del Governo in materia di spesa pubblica e politica internazionale. Gli organizzatori contestano “i finanziamenti destinati agli armamenti e chiedono maggiori risorse per scuola, sanità, edilizia popolare e contrasto al carovita”. Tra le richieste indicate nel volantino c’è anche quella di “tassare gli extraprofitti” degli speculatori.




La mobilitazione viene presentata dagli organizzatori come parte di un più ampio clima di protesta nazionale, richiamando anche le giornate di sciopero generale del 30 ottobre e del 20 novembre e le iniziative di protesta di autotrasportatori, agricoltori, studenti e movimenti. 

Ad organizzare la manifestazione il collettivo studentesco “Corrente Z” col supporto di associazioni come Arci, Circolo Arcipelago, Arci Persichello, Fiom e sindacati di base.




La presentazione con Silvia dell’Arci Persichello di Cremona







Il Collettivo Studentesco Corrente Zeta si è dato appuntamento alle 13 all’autostazione per raggiungere poi tutti e tutte insieme il concentramento del corteo. Sentiamo Sofia del “Corrente Z” di Cremona

author: Bulatlat Contributors
title: Rural communities face continuing violence amid militarization
content:
Photo by Viggo Sarmago/Bulatlat

Under the blazing sun in front Camp Aguinaldo, palay hats stood out together with the line of banners. It was not a celebration for peasants — but a plea to end militarization, violence, and to serve justice for Negros 19 killed in Toboso, Negros Occidental on April 19, 2026.

Farmers and fisherfolk play a vital role in sustaining the nation’s food security and economy, yet they are the ones who struggle the most to survive.

Pamalakaya’s National Vice Chairperson Ronnel Arambulo stated in his speech during the fourth day of peasant month protest on October 19, that the administration does not aim to protect the life and rights of the people, farmers, and fisherfolk, but to protect the ruling class, the foreigners, and the people in power for their own personal interest.

Fisherfolks are also facing harassment that disrupts their lives. According to Arambulo, there are recent reports of intimidation in Binangonan, Rizal, where fisherfolk were called by Maritime Police to appear at the municipal hall. They were later summoned to renounce and abandon Pamalakaya.

This kind of intimidation is not confined to the province of Rizal, as similar deployments have also been reported in other regions.

Nida Barcenas from Karapatan-Bicol stated that the 9th Infantry “Spear” Division of Philippine Army or at least ten battalions of men in uniform were scattered around six provinces in Bicol region.

During the “Stakeholder and Media Fellowship Night: Episode 1 – Kaakibat sa Kapayapaan,” event of 9th Infantry Division held on April 18, 2026 at Camp Elias Angeles, Maj. Gen. Aldwine I. Almase recognized the efforts of national agencies, local government units, media personalities, and other stakeholders in countering alleged local terrorist activities to ensure peace and safety in the Bicol region.

For Karapatan-Bicol , however, these achievements actually meant human rights abuses against farmers communities. As of March 2026, Karapatan has recorded 46 political prisoners in Bicol — 9 of them are women, with 22 arrested under Marcos Jr. administration. In his four year term in the government, two enforced disappearances and 38 extrajudicial killings have also been documented.

Red-tagging, violence, and land grabbing continue to disrupt the lives of Bicolanos, Barcenas said.

“To this day, residents of Masbate continue to appeal for help amid alleged land grabbing by Governor Kho. Farmers are being driven off their lands, and those who resist are killed and red-tagged as NPAs, [New People’s Army]” Barcenas said.

The issue involving Governor Antonio Kho is also part of the problem regarding land dispute over the Pecson Estate in Cawayan, Masbate. Kilusang Magbubukid ng Pilipinas (KMP) stated that Kho took over a portion of 1,807-hectare estate, forcing more than 100 farmers off the lands they have cultivated for years.

The agrarian conflict has also been associated with reports of killing involving peasants in Cawayan. A human rights report from Karapatan revealed cases including killings of farmers named Pancho Versaga and Renard Remulta on October 28, 2022 in Sitio Villaluna, Barangay Itom-Bato, Cawayan. These two were among more than 100 farmers tilling a 450-hectare portion of the Pecson Estate within land seized by Kho in Masbate.

Karapatan has declared Masbate as Bicol’s killing fields due to an increasing number of victims who had been killed under Marcos Jr. regime’s counter-insurgency war on the province.

One of the heinous cases was the killing of a farmer couple Aimee and Jover Villegas, a two-hectare land caretaker. The military said that the couple died under armed encounters. However, their injuries contradict this claim as Aimee’s throat, chin, and neck had been slashed, while Jover sustained gunshot wounds in the nape and back.

Echoing this concern, Grace Nabian from Amihan-Negros called for a stop to the militarization in rural communities.

She questioned killings, abduction, and threats against farmers, stressing that land reform, and access to quality education for their children are what they need.

She also pressed his demand to hold Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) accountable for various deaths in their land including Negros 19.

During an afternoon mass in a collective protest campout in front of the Department of Agrarian Reform, Sol Santuyo, mother of Maureen Santuyo, emphasized the long-overdue demand of farmers that were ignored by the government.

“From then until now, our farmers have had one cry, but those in power deliberately turn a deaf ear. I hope a better way is found, so that no more youth would have to risk their lives just to help our farmers,” Santuyo, whose daughter was among those killed in Toboso, said.

Various organizations along with other student activists continue to call for justice for Santuyo, Alyssa Alano, RJ Ledesma, and Errol Wendell, Lyle Prijoles, Kai Sorem, and others but to all farmers, fisherfolk, journalists, and residents who were killed, abducted, threatened, and deprived of land and rights. (RVO)

author: anred
title: «La visita del Papa debe poner en evidencia la crisis que el Gobierno quiere tapar»
content:
El secretario general de ATE Nacional, Rodolfo Aguiar, reclamó que la próxima visita del papa León XIV a la Argentina no quede reducida a una agenda protocolar y que sirva para visibilizar las consecuencias sociales de las políticas económicas del gobierno de Javier Milei. «Milei no quiere paz. Lo quiere al Papa como escudo. Quiere lavarse las manos con él. Lo quiere utilizar para tapar el sufrimiento del pueblo argentino», sostuvo el dirigente, quien pidió que el Pontífice «mire más allá del protocolo», que «muestre todo lo que el Gobierno quiere tapar» y sea «la voz de los argentinos que están sufriendo». León XIV llegará este domingo 8 de noviembre y permanecerá en el país hasta el miércoles 11. Durante su estadía visitará Buenos Aires, Claypole, Córdoba y Luján, tendrá encuentros con representantes del mundo del trabajo, autoridades políticas, dirigentes religiosos y jóvenes, y celebrará misas multitudinarias. Mientras el Gobierno prepara un importante operativo institucional, de seguridad y transporte, organizaciones sindicales y movimientos sociales buscarán poner en agenda la pobreza, la pérdida de empleo, el endeudamiento familiar y el deterioro de las condiciones de vida. 

Por ANRed.







El secretario general de la Asociación Trabajadores del Estado (ATE) Nacional, 

Rodolfo Aguiar

, reclamó que 

la próxima visita del papa León XIV a la Argentina sirva para visibilizar las consecuencias sociales y económicas de las políticas del gobierno de Javier Milei

. «Al Papa 

le quieren mostrar una Argentina maquillada, y su visita tiene que mostrar la crisis que estamos atravesando

», sostuvo el dirigente, quien pidió al Pontífice que «mire más allá del protocolo» y sea «la voz de los argentinos que están sufriendo».




Aguiar también cuestionó el mensaje que Milei publicó en sus redes sociales, en el que pidió que la visita papal «fortalezca la fe, renueve la esperanza y lleve un mensaje de paz a todos los argentinos». «

¿De verdad el Presidente le pidió a León XIV traiga paz al pueblo argentino? No puede haber paz sin justicia social. No puede haber paz sin trabajo. No puede haber paz sin paz. Milei no quiere paz. Lo quiere al Papa como escudo. Quiere lavarse las manos con él. Lo quiere utilizar para tapar el sufrimiento del pueblo argentino

», afirmó. El dirigente reclamó que 

la Iglesia ponga en evidencia «la realidad de jubilados que no pueden comprar sus remedios, de los pibes que se van a dormir sin comer» y sostuvo que «ningún ajuste puede cerrar con los trabajadores afuera»

.




Imagen: prensa ATE Nacional.




El planteo no es aislado: 

distintos sectores sociales, sindicales y empresariales buscan que la visita tenga una agenda vinculada con la crisis económica y social

.




En septiembre, 

Alejandro «Peluca» Gramajo

, secretario general de la 

Unión de Trabajadores y Trabajadoras de la Economía Popular (UTEP)

, entregó personalmente a León XIV un 

informe de 72 páginas sobre la situación argentina

. El documento aborda la 

pérdida del poder adquisitivo, el endeudamiento de las familias, los problemas de salud mental, la situación de los jubilados y trabajadores, los discursos de odio y la criminalización de la protesta

. A fines de octubre, una delegación del Vaticano participó también de un encuentro regional organizado por la UTEP en La Matanza, destinado a acercar las preocupaciones de los movimientos populares al Pontífice.







La CGT, empresarios y movimientos sociales también trabajan en un documento conjunto

 sobre la situación económica nacional para presentarlo durante el encuentro con el mundo del trabajo en la UCA. Entre quienes impulsan esa iniciativa aparecen 

Jorge Sola

, dirigente de la CGT, y 

Osvaldo Cornide

, expresidente de la Confederación Argentina de la Mediana Empresa (CAME). La propuesta busca instalar un diagnóstico sobre la pérdida de empleo, el deterioro de los ingresos y las dificultades que atraviesan las pequeñas y medianas empresas. Desde la conducción sindical plantearon la posibilidad de utilizar la reunión para impulsar un espacio de diálogo entre trabajadores y empresarios.




En paralelo,

 la Iglesia busca evitar que la visita sea utilizada para señalamientos políticos, aunque distintos referentes eclesiásticos reconocen su preocupación por el impacto del ajuste sobre los sectores más vulnerables

.




La expectativa de que León XIV se refiera a la pobreza, el trabajo, las desigualdades y la justicia social también se apoya en sus propias intervenciones anteriores

. En su exhortación apostólica 

Dilexi te

, publicada en octubre de 2025, el Papa sostuvo la necesidad de «

resolver las causas estructurales de la pobreza

» y cuestionó los modelos económicos que privilegian el éxito y el individualismo por encima de la dignidad humana. Allí escribió: «Hay reglas económicas que resultaron eficaces para el crecimiento, pero no así para el desarrollo humano integral. 

Aumentó la riqueza, pero con inequidad, y así lo que ocurre es que “nacen nuevas pobrezas”

». También afirmó que «

la falta de equidad es raíz de los males sociales

». Por eso, distintas organizaciones esperan que esos planteos encuentren expresión durante su paso por Argentina, aunque el contenido exacto de sus discursos todavía no está anunciado.




Imagen: AFP




León XIV llegará este domingo 8 de noviembre y permanecerá en el país hasta el miércoles 11

. La visita apostólica, organizada por la 

Conferencia Episcopal Argentina bajo el lema

 «Bienvenidos todos. Vayan y anuncien», se desarrollará durante cuatro días en tres ciudades: 

Buenos Aires, Córdoba y Luján

. El 

cronograma oficial

 contempla 

22 actos

, 

cinco de ellos abiertos a la participación del público.

 León XIV llegará el domingo 8 a las 16.30 al Aeroparque Jorge Newbery, procedente de Montevideo. A las 17 visitará el Monumento al General San Martín, a las 17.20 será recibido en la Casa Rosada y a las 18.30 participará de un encuentro con autoridades, representantes de la sociedad civil y el cuerpo diplomático en el Palacio Libertad.




El lunes 9, a las 9.15, visitará el Pequeño Cottolengo Don Orione, en Claypole, donde se encontrará con el personal y las personas asistidas por la institución. A las 11.30 celebrará una misa en el Monumento de los Españoles, en Palermo. Por la tarde tendrá uno de los encuentros de mayor interés político y social de la visita: a las 16.10 se reunirá con representantes del mundo del trabajo en la Universidad Católica Argentina (UCA), en Puerto Madero. También mantendrá un encuentro con referentes de distintas tradiciones religiosas en el Palacio San Martín y participará de las vísperas con el Episcopado argentino en la Catedral Metropolitana.







El martes 10 viajará a Córdoba, donde celebrará una misa a las 10 en el predio de la Fábrica Argentina de Aviones (FAdeA) y, a las 15.15, se encontrará con obispos, sacerdotes, religiosos, seminaristas y agentes pastorales en la Catedral Nuestra Señora de la Asunción. Por la noche regresará a Buenos Aires para participar, a las 20.15, de una vigilia con jóvenes en el Monumento de los Españoles. El miércoles 11, antes de partir hacia Lima, Perú, visitará a las 8 el Complejo Penitenciario Federal de Buenos Aires y celebrará a las 10 una misa en la plaza de la Basílica de Nuestra Señora de Luján. La ceremonia de despedida está prevista para las 13.30 en Ezeiza y su partida para las 14.




Los preparativos incluyen un 

amplio despliegue institucional, logístico y de seguridad

. El Gobierno nacional, la Ciudad de Buenos Aires, la provincia de Buenos Aires, Córdoba y los municipios involucrados vienen coordinando las actividades junto con la Conferencia Episcopal y representantes del Vaticano. Una de las medidas anunciadas es un operativo especial de transporte: colectivos y trenes circularán con frecuencias de día hábil durante los feriados establecidos por la visita, se incorporarán servicios ferroviarios nocturnos y se entregaron 24.000 tarjetas SUBE con viajes gratuitos para voluntarios que colaborarán en la organización. También se prevén traslados especiales de unos 4.000 voluntarios hacia Luján. La última avanzada del Vaticano, integrada por 26 funcionarios vaticanos, llegó al país para revisar los escenarios, los altares, los recorridos del Papamóvil y los dispositivos de seguridad.




La visita se desarrollará así entre dos agendas que se cruzan: la institucional y pastoral de la Iglesia, y la expectativa de trabajadores/as, jubilados/as, movimientos populares y organizaciones sociales de que el Pontífice visibilice las consecuencias de la política económica nacional. Mientras el Gobierno insiste en que no se haga un uso político de su presencia, ATE y otros sectores reclaman que no se oculte la situación de quienes atraviesan dificultades para llegar a fin de mes, acceder a medicamentos, sostener sus empleos o garantizar la alimentación familiar.
